phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen/ tshangs spyod la nyer gnas kyi dge bsnyen/ go ma'i dge bsnyen dang bdun gsungs shing / de dag len pa'i tshe rang rang gi ming gis smos pa'i tshul gyis len dgos pa yin no/ /dper na/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du/ btsun pas bzung du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ go mi'i dge bsnyen du btsun pas bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod dgos par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi bsam pa bskyed pa'i phyir du dang por dge 'dun la rab tu byung bar zhu/ de nas mkhan por lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba 'debs/ grogs dan du bskos pa'i dge slong gis gtsug phud bregs pa dang / khrus byas pa'i rjes su mkhan pos bsgrub bya la stod g.yogs smad g.yogs lhung bzed gding ba chu tshags lnga byin nas rtags brje bar byed/ rtags dang mthun par khyim pa'i bsam pa spangs nas 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos gtso bor sgrub pa'i sems bskyed pa ni bsam pa brje ba'o/ /de dag mi brjed pa'i brdar ming brje ba ste/ brje ba gsum yan chad byed pa ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rab tu byung ba'i phan yon dang / phan yon dang ldan pa'i rab byung sgrub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo las/ khyim pa rnams ni me'i 'obs na gnas pa lta bu/ rab tu byung ba rnams ni bsil ba'i khang pa na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang / khyim pa ni bu dang chung ma la sogs pa 'dod yon gyis bcings pa'i dbang gis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob dka'/

rab tu byung ba rnams ni 'dod yon la rang gi ngang gis chags bral byed nus pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob sla ba'i phan yon yod pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyang khyim pa'i rten las sangs rgyas pa ma yin gyi/ rab tu byung ba'i rten las sangs rgyas par bshad pa yin te/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dag ni rab tu bsten byed cing / /bu dang chung ma dag la sred bskyed nas/ /smad par bya ba'i khyim la brten pa de/ /bla med byang chub dam pa gzhar mi thob/ /gang dag 'dod pa lci skam me bzhin spong / /bu dang chung ma dag la sred spangs nas/ /khyim gyis skrag ste khyim nas mngon byung ba/ /de dag byang chub mchog 'di rnyed mi dka'/ /gang dag khyim na gnas par byed bzhin du/ /byang chub dam pa mchog 'di thob pa yi/ /sangs rgyas gang yang sngon chad ma byung ste/ /ma 'ongs pa na'ang mi 'byung gnas pa med/ /rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas/ /dben par dong ste dgon par gnas byed pa/ /nyon mongs spangs te bdud ni bcom nas su/ /byang chub rdul med 'dus ma byas 'tshang rgya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhan pos bsgrub bya la/ khyim pa'i nyes dmigs rab tu byung ba'i phan yon nges 'byung gi bsam pa gsal btab pa sngon du btang nas/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi zhes pa nas/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ shākya'i seng ge shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu byung ste/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ngo / /rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par len no/ /zhes pa lan gsum bzlas pa ni/ bar ma rab byung du sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ bsgrub bya la dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i dge slong des/ bsgrub bya de nyid la 'khor ba spangs pa'i byang chub la don gnyer gyi bsam pa skye dgos pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa gsal btab/ 'gal rkyen nyes pa lnga dang bral ba dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga'i tshig lan gsum brjod de/ dge tshul du bsgrub par bya ba yin te/ mdo rtsar/ skyabs su 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i tshig rtsom pa dang / dge tshul nyid du khas blangs pa'i tshig bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bslab pa brjod pa khas blangs pa'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes pa'i phyir du dus go brjod pa dang / sdom pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i phyir du bslab pa brjod pa ni lag len bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de skad du yang / karma sha tam las/ /sngon dang dge bsnyen bslab pa dang / /zhu dang mkhan po dang po dang / /rab byung dge tshul grib tshod dang / /bslab pa brjod pa tha ma yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum/ dang po la/ yo byad tshags su gzhug cing slob dpon mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du dang por bya ba/ mkhan po mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du mkhan por gsol ba 'debs pa/ yo byad mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir du chos gos lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs nas byin pa/ yongs su dag pa mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du gsang ston gyis lkog tu bar chad dris te nang du 'ong ba zhu ba/ gsol ba mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir du dge 'dun la gsol ba gdab pa/ yongs su dag pa dang gtso bor dge 'dun thugs yid ches pa'i phyir du mngon sum du bar chad 'dri ba dang drug dang po ni/ mkhan po'i sta gon du gnas pa'i dge slong des dge 'dun la snyan gsan phab nas/

las kyi slob dpon dang gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon tshig tsam gyi sgo nas bsko bar bya ba yin te/ mdo rtsar/ mkhan po nyid du phyogs par gyur pas las byed pa dang gsang ste ston pa'i dge slong la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu bar ma chad du lon pa'i btsun pa brtan pa'i yan lag dang / lnga phrugs tu sbyar ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung dang ldan pa'i mkhas shing phan 'dogs kyi yan lag ste/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong la mkhan por lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mkhan po de nyid kyis bsgrub bya la snam sbyar bla gos mthang gos lhung bzed dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs nas ster zhing / gding ba chu tshags tshig tsam gyi sgo nas sbyin par bya ba yin no/ /de yang yo byad drug po ni/ rang dbang ba'am brnyan po tshun chad kyis yod pa gcig dgos te/ mdo rtsar/ lhung bzed med pa rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs par mi bya'o/ /brnyan pos kyang de nyid dang bcas pa yin no/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa la/ las slob kyi bya ba dang / gsang ston gyi bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ las slob tu mngon du phyogs pa'i dge slong des las gral na gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi rgyud kyi ltung bas las chags pa la mi sgrib par bya ba'i phyir du ltung ba thun mong du byin gyis rlob pa gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las byed/ de nas dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun pa'i phyir du gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis gnas la blo mthun par byed/ de'i rjes su gsang ston la spro ba dris nas gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis gsang ston bsko bar byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bskos pa'i gsang ston des dge 'dun gyi lkog tu bsgrub bya la bar chad kyi chos rnams dris pa'i rjes su dge 'dun la bsgrub bya bar chad kyi chos yongs su dag tshul brjod nas nang du 'ong ba zhu bar byed pa yin no/

/lnga pa ni/ sdom pa myur du skye ba dang gsol ba mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du/ bsgrub bya des dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i gsol ba lan gsum gyi bar du 'debs par byed pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ las kyi slob dpon du mngon du phyogs pa'i dge slong des dge 'dun gyi dbus su gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las sngon du btang nas/ bsgrub bya de nyid bar chad kyi chos kyis yongs su dag par dge 'dun thugs yid ches par bya ba'i phyir du mngon sum du bar chad 'dri ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ las slob tu phyogs pa'i dge slong des gdams ngag gi bshad pa cung zad brda sprad/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las go rim ma 'khrugs pa ngo bo ma nor ba lhag chad med par brjod pa'i sgo nas bsgrub bya bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lung drang pa dang / de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung gcig las 'phros pa'i bcu pa las/ mngon du gyur pas bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur ba bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ ston pa mngon du gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas/ chos/ mkhan po/ slob dpon/ bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa'i yo byad/ yongs su dag pa/ gsol ba mngon du gyur pa dang / las mngon du gyur pas bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la bcu yod pa las/ dang po ston pa mngon du gyur pa ni dge 'dun yin la/ 'di nyid la grangs tshang ba kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bsgrub bya bsnyen par rdzogs pa la yul dbus su dge slong bcu/ mtha' 'khob tu dge slong lnga yan chad tshang dgos te/ mdo rtsar/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa la ni bcu la sogs pa'o/ /mtha' 'khob dag tu med na 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang lnga la sogs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dmigs bsal la dge slong bzhi tsam la brten nas kyang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba yod de/

mkhan po med pa dang gsang ston med par yang bsgrub bya'i rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba yod pa'i phyir te/ mkhan por gsol ba ma btab pa dang bar chad ma dris par bsgrub bya'i rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog pa la skye la nyes bcas su bshad pa'i phyir te/ de dang ldan pa'i ltar mkhan po med pa nyid la yang ngo zhes dang / tshigs snga ma med pa nyid la ni nyes byas tsam du zad do/ /mkhan por ma gsol ba la yang ngo / /bar chad ma dris par yang ngo / /zhes dang / 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas par/ mkhan po gtan med nyid dang ni/ /khyim pa'i rtags can yin yang rung / /zhes dang / gal te bzhi ni las brjod mkhas/ /tshul khrims ldan par gyur na ni/ /bsnyen rdzogs ma smad gyur pa ste/ /lha yis kyang ni phyag byar 'os/ /zhes dang / lung zhu ba las/ mtha' 'khob tu lngas bsnyen par rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes gang gsungs pa de la lnga'am lnga las lhag pa mchis bzhin du bzhis bsnyen par rdzogs na rdzogs zhes bgyi'am ma rdzogs zhes bgyi/ nye ba 'khor rdzogs zhes bya ste/ rdzogs par byed pa dag la 'das pa dang bcas par ro/ /zhes so/ /gal te mi 'thad de/ rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa de'i phyir dge slong 'ga' zhig la mkhan po nyid du gnas pa la'o/ /zhes pa dang / 'dul ba lung las/ gang zag gsum ni bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ bdag gi ming ma brjod pa dang mkhan po'i ming ma brjod pa dang sdom pa thob pa'i dus mi shes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ de dag nyes med phun tshogs kyi dbang du byas pa'i sdom pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'greng yul 'dun sogs phul ba min/ /ma rdzogs nyams dang mtshams med min/ /sdig sa tha dad 'khrul bcas min/ /mtshams mtshan dkon mchog gzhan min pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ma 'dus pa'i mi mthun pa dang bral ba dang /

'dus pa phyir ldog pa'i mi mthun pa dang bral ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'du bar 'os pa'i dge slong rnams las gral der tshang bar 'dus pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las gral de na gnas pa'i dge slong chos ldan 'ga' zhig gis las 'di byar mi rung zhes bzlog pa dang bral nas dge 'dun thams cad cang mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis las la gnang ba ster bar zhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro'i yul du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas la dad pa dang ldan zhing / kun rdzob brdar mtshon pa'i sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can gyi sku gzugs dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lung sde bzhi'am de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ las gral na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i bslab pa rin po che gsum lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong la mkhan por gsol ba btab pa khas blangs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /lnga pa la/ las kyi slob dpon dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha skong gi chos dang ldan zhing dge 'dun gyi dbus su cho ga brda sprod pa la mkhas pa zhig la mkhan pos tshig tsam gyi sgo nas las slob tu bskos pa'i dge slong dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha skong gi chos dang ldan zhing 'gro ba ma yin pa bzhi dang bral ba lkog tu bar chad 'dri ba la mkhas pa dge 'dun gyi gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis gsang ston du bskos pa'i dge slong gcig dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /drug pa la/ lus kyi rten dang / bsam pa'i rten gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad dang mi ldan zhing rgyud tshogs su ma tshang ba sdom rnying pas rgyud ma bkag pa tshigs snga ma dge tshul yan chad sngon du song zhing chags pa'o/ /tshigs snga ma sngon du ma song ba la dge slong gi sdom pa mi skye ba ma yin te/

de dag la skye la nyes byas tsam du bshad pa'i phyir te/ tshigs snga ma med pa la ni nyes byas tsam du zad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod/ dus kyi kun slong thob shes/ 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral gyi bsam pa/ mthun rkyen phun tshogs gsum ldan gyi bsam pa/ de thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar du zhe thag pa nas len 'dod kyi bsam pa dgos te/ mdo rtsa bar/ bzhad gad kyi dngos po ni cir yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa thob pa la thob pa'i dus ngo shes pa dgos te/ gzhan du na nyes med phun tshogs kyi sdom pa mi 'chags par bshad pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gsum ni bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ gsum gang zhe na bdag gi ming ma brjod pa dang mkhan po'i ming ma brjod pa dang sdom pa thob pa'i dus mi shes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ yul/ dus/ yan lag sems can/ gnas skabs nges pa dang bral ba'o/ /dang po ni/ yul 'ga' zhig tu bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bsrung bar 'dod cing yul thams cad du bsrung 'dod med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lo dang zla ba la sogs pa dus 'ga' zhig tu bsrung 'dod yod kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung 'dod med pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i bslab bya rags pa 'ga' zhig bsrung 'dod yod kyang mtha' dag bsrung bar mi 'dod pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can 'ga' zhig la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa spong nus kyang rang la gnod byed kyi dgra bo la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa spong mi nus pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu bslab bya la slob par byed kyi de las gzhan du slob par mi 'dod pa'o/ /des na 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga po de dang bral nas yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du sems can thams cad la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa spangs te dge slong gi bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la slob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dgos so/

/bzhi pa ni/ gang la sdom pa blang bar bya ba'i yul/ sdom pa 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga len pa po rang nyid dang bcas pa la yid ches kyi bsam pa phun tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong nas spong 'dod kyi bsam pa/ thar pa'i phan yon mthong nas sgrub 'dod kyi bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub don gnyer gyi nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin dgos te/ de las gzhan du tshe 'di'i lto gos kyis 'jigs pa dang rgyal po'i chad pa sogs kyis 'jigs pas blangs kyang 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims tsam du 'gyur zhing phyi ma lha mi'i phun tshogs tsam thob phyir du blangs kyang legs smon gyi tshul khrims tsam du 'gyur gyi so thar gyi sdom par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ mdo rtsa bar/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes dang / sum brgya par/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong / /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel las/ ci phyi rol pa la yang yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i tshul khrims yod dam zhe na/ yod mod kyi so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni srid pa la brten pa'i phyir gtan du sdig pa mi dge ba las thar bar byed pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdun pa la/ lus kyi byi byad kyi rtags/ gos kyi rtags/ snod spyad kyi rtags dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'breg par 'os pa'i skra dang kha spu sogs bregs shing khrus byas pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos rnam pa gsum gding ba chu tshags rnams rung zhing tshad dang ldan pa brnyan po tshun chad kyis yod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rung ba tshad dang ldan pa'i lhung bzed dge 'dun la bstan/ mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs nas byin pa de nyid brnyan po tshun chad kyis yod pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ gsang ston gyis lkog tu bar chad dris/

las slob kyis dge 'dun gyi dbus su bar chad dris pa'i stobs kyis bsgrub bya de nyid bar chad kyis dag par dge 'dun rnams yid ches pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ las slob kyis grogs byas te dge 'dun la gsol ba lan gsum btab pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ las slob tu phyogs pa'i dge slong des sngar bshad pa'i mngon gyur bcu'i bshad pa rnams brda sprad nas de'i rjes su dang por gsol ba'i las/ de'i rjes su brjod pa'i las lhag chad nor ba'i skyon dang bral bar lan gsum brjod par byed pas so/ /de yang don go ba la mi gnod na tshig gi go rim cung zad 'khrugs pa tsam gyis sdom pa 'chags pa'i gegs su mi 'gyur te/ mdo rtsa bar/ dgongs su gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni pha rol gyi sems gtad pa nyid gtso bo yin no/ /don gyi skabs dag go rim 'khrugs pas ni mi 'chags pa ma yin no/ /de ni mi bya ba nyid do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes pa'i phyir du dus go brjod pa dang / sdom pa thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i phyir du bslab bya brjod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gang la brjod pa'i yul/ gang gis brjod pa'i gang zag ji ltar du brjod pa'i tshul/ de ltar brjod pa'i dgos pa dang bzhi'i sgo nas shes par bya ba yin mod kyang 'dul ba'i spyi don gyi skabs su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gdams ngag bcu gcig brjod pa'i tshul lag len ltar shes par bya'o/ /de skad du yang / karmā sha tam las/ dang por bya dang mkhan po dang / /chos gos gnyis dang lhung bzed gnyis/ /spro bya gsol ba gsang ston dang / /zhu dang gsol dang gsol ba dang / /dri dang las dang grib tshod dang / /nyin mtshan dus tshod gnas rnams dang / /ltung dang dge sbyong mchog 'dod dang / /tshul khrims mnyam dang tshul 'grel dang / /dus dang dgos dang ma brjod dang / /gus pa dang ni bsgrub bya ba/ /mu stegs gnas pa byin pa yis/

/sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa bud med kyi cho ga'i khyad par la/ yul gyi/ tshigs kyi/ sdom pa byin tshul gyi/ gdams ngag brjod tshul gyi khyad par/ dogs gcad dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dge slob ma dang tshangs spyod la nye bar gnas pa'i snga rol gyi sdom pa gnyis ni/ yul dbus su dge slong ma'i dge 'dun grangs bcu gnyis tshang bas gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis sbyin/ mtha' 'khob tu drug gis gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis sbyin no/ /dge slong ma'i sdom pa ni gnyis ka'i dge 'dun gyis sbyin dgos/ de yang yul dbus su pha'i tshogs bcu/ ma'i tshogs bcu gnyis te nyer gnyis tshang dgos/ mtha' 'khob tu pha'i tshogs lnga dang ma'i tshogs drug gis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes pa la dge bsnyen bar ma rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs te tshigs bzhi yin la/ bud med la de'i steng du/ dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi bar du/ dge slob ma dang tshangs spyod la nyer gnas kyi sdom pa gnyis len dgos pas drug go /tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa ni dge slob ma'i sdom pa dang rdzas rigs gcig tu 'dod do/ /gsum pa ni/ dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul sbyin tshul snga ma dang 'dra la/ de'i rjes su dge slob ma'i sdom pa byin nas de la lo gnyis kyi bar du slob/ de'i rjes su dge slong ma'i dge 'dun gyi gsang ste ston mas lkog tu bar chad dri/ de'i rjes su las byed pa mos mngon sum du bar chad dris nas tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa sbyin par byed/ de'i rjes su gnyis ka'i dge 'dun tshogs pa la gsol ba btab nas las kyi slob dpon du 'os pa'i dge slong gis dge slong ma'i sdom pa gsol bzhi'i las kyis sbyin par byed pa yin te/ mdo rtsa bar/ tshangs par spyod pa la nye bar gnas pa'i sdom pa ma thob par bsnyen par rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/

/gsang ste bstan pa'i 'og tu dge 'dun gyis de sbyin par bya'o/ /bar chad dris nas so/ /gsol ba byas nas so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtags dang cha lugs sbyin pa'i skabs su/ chos gos gsum shing nga dpung chad rngul gzan dang lnga sbyin dgos/ gdams ngag gi skabs su/ gnas rnams kyi nang nas shing drung ma gtogs pa dang pham pa brgyad lci ba'i chos brgyad rnams brjod dgos te/ mdo rtsa bar/ chos gos dag ni lnga nyid do/ /gnas rnams la shing drung nyid ma gtogs so/ /ltung bar 'gyur ba rnams la brgyad nyid do/ /lci ba'i chos rnams brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ kha cig yul dge slong pha'i dge 'dun gyis bud med la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa byin na skye ba med de/ dge slong ma'i sdom pa skye ba'i sngon du thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gnyis sngon du 'gro dgos la de dag dge slong ma'i dge 'dun kho na la skye bar bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ mkhas pa gzhan dag na re/ dge slong pha'i dge 'dun tsam la brten nas bud med la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba yod de/ mdo rtsa bar/ mtshan gzhan la brten pas ni mi 'chags pa ma yin no/ /dge slong dang dge slong ma nyid dag gi las gzhan byed pas kyang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgrub byed kyang ma nges te/ tshigs snga ma sngon du ma song ba la skye la nyes byas tsam du bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i lugs gnyis yod cing / nyes med phun tshogs kyi dge slong ma'i sdom pa skye ba la/ tshigs drug rim can du 'bogs pa dang / gnyis ka'i dge 'dun dgos pa yin la/ skyes la nyes byas tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ dge slong pha'i dge 'dun tsam la brten nas kyang dge slong ma'i sdom pa skye ba yod pa rigs pa mngon no/ /gnyis pa theg chen so thar la/ gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag ji ltar len pa'i cho ga dang gsum/

dang po ni/ grub mtha' 'og ma ltar du yul nges pa can kho na ma yin te/ rten la sogs pa'i drung du rang nyid kyis blangs kyang skye ba yod pa dang / khyim pa'i cha lugs can gyis dge slong gi sdom pa phog pa la nyes med phun tshogs kyi sdom pa skye ba yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir so thar gyi sdom pa tsam skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag la 'gro ba rigs drug ka yod de/ byang sems kyi sdom pa dngos su skye ba'i rten la 'gro ba rigs drug ka yod cing / byang sems kyi sdom pa gang la skye ba'i rten la theg chen gyi so thar gyi sdom pa yang skye dgos pa'i phyir te/ byang sdom dang theg chen so thar kyi sdom pa don gcig la ming gi rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i theg chen so thar ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med mtshan don byed nus pa dang ldan pa kho na la skye'i de las gzhan pa la ma yin te/ nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs nas de ltar bshad cing rten gyi gang zag dang 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga nyan thos kyi gzhung dang mthun cing / bsam pa theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa la cho ga nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i theg chen so thar du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa len tshul dang / cho ga nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so thar gyi sdom pa len tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ da ltar gyi cho ga dang / sngon gyi cho ga gnyis/ dang po ni/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa nas bshad cing gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa slob dpon nam rten gang rung gi drung du cho ga'i sgo nas len par byed pa dang / byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len par byed pa dang / cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po snying rje cher sems kyis gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du khas blangs par bshad pa lta bu yin te/

cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ rab byung yon tan du ma ldan pa zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs mod kyi/ /de ltar lags kyang snying rjer gyur pas na/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag gis rgyal srid bsgrubs/ /ji srid 'tsho bar tshangs par spyod byed cing / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa blang bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyal ba byams pas khyim bdag dgu stong / rgyal sras spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i blo gros 'jam dbyangs kyis khyim bdag bdun stong rnams bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la bkod par gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /mdo der bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga dngos su ma gsungs shing / sngon rgyud yongs su smin pa'i gang zag tshegs chung ngu'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa la sngon gyi cho ga'i ming btags pa tsam yin no/ /de skad du yang / rgyal sras byams pa 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /bdag nyid chen po 'ga' zhig gis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gal te 'di dag mi 'thad de/ 'dir sngon chog la mkhan po bshad cing mkhan po ni da ltar gyi cho ga kho na'i khyad chos su 'dul ba las bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer na/ skyon med de/ 'dir tshegs chung ngu'i sgo nas bsgrub bya bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la 'god par byed mkhan la mkhan po'i ming btags pa tsam yin gyi/ mkhan por lan gsum gsol ba btab nas mkhan por khas blangs pa de ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam pa theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas so thar rigs brgyad 'bogs pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga sngar bshad pa'i nyan thos kyi lugs ji lta ba bzhin du byed dgos te/ de ltar byas pa la brten nas theg chen so thar rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa thob par nus pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / des na da lta'i cho ga ni/

/bsam pa sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar ro/ /de yang theg chen so thar rigs bdun cho ga nyan thos dang mthun par len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs bdun len pa'i cho ga dngos su ma bshad pa dang / gtan phab bsdu bar/ dge tshul man chad rang nyid kyis blangs pas chog pa dang / dge slong gzhan kho na las len pa'i tshig 'bru tsam zhig gsungs kyang de dag len pa'i cho ga gsal por ma gsungs pa'i phyir te/ gtan phab bsdu ba las/ de dag las la la ni rang kho nas len par byed de dge slong gi sdom pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dge slong gi sdom pa ni thams cad kyis yang dag par blang par 'os pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa byang sdom thob par byed pa'i rgyu la/ gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag ji ltar len pa'i cho ga dang gsum/ dang po ni/ byang sems gyi sdom pa dang ldan zhing byang sdom 'bogs pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du len dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes dang / /sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan las blang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang dbu ma pa ltar na/ dang por len pa dang phyis gso ba gnyis ka bla ma'am dkon mchog gi rten gang rung gi drung du len gso byed pas chog par bzhed/ sems tsam pa ltar na/ bla ma'i drung du bgrod pa la srog dang tshangs spyod la sogs pa'i bar chad med na bla ma'i drung du nges par len/ de lta bu'i bar chad yod na dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du rang nyid kyis blangs kyang skye bar bzhed de/ byang sa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyang grags dang dpag tshad kyi bar du srog dang tshangs spyod la mi gnod tsam du btsal kyang ma rnyed na dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du bdag nyid kyis blangs pas kyang skye'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyams na gso ba la ni bla ma nges par dgos zhes gnas brtan byang bzang la sogs pa bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ dbu ma pa'i dang / sems tsam pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ brda shes shing don go la len 'dod yod pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag byang sems kyi sdom pa skye ba'i rten du rung ste/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi shar phyogs nags tshal sā la sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhes bya bar chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan pas rgya mtsho'i klu stong phrag gsum bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bskal pa bzang po las/ rgyal ba phan bzhed grong dpon gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od de la/ /nyin gcig srog gcod sdom pa blangs nas kyang / /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du nam mkha'i snying po dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo la sogs pa las gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems skyed 'di/ /sems can kun gyis legs thob na/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhes/ /mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ /de yang sdong po bkod pa dang / /bskal bzang nam mkha'i snying po dang / /dkon brtsegs rgyal po gdams pa yi/ /mdo sde la sogs rnams su ltos/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med mtshan don byed nus pa dang ldan pa kho na la dngos su skye bar 'dod de/ 'di'i lugs la/ byang sdom dngos su skye ba la rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa gcig dgos/ rigs bdun ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med mtshan don byed nus pa dang ldan pa kho na la skye bar bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ jo bo rjes/ so so thar pa ris bdun gyi/

/rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ cho ga'i byung tshul spyir bstan pa dang / lugs gnyis kyi khyad par so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dbu ma lugs dang / sems tsam lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la brgyud de rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i phyag srol jo bo puṇ+ye shrī las byung ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi phyag len du mdzad pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal gyi yi dam blang ba'i cho ga rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug dang bslab btus nas bshad pa ltar/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sems bskyed kyi cho ga chen mor bkod pa ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa byams pa nas thogs med sku mched la brgyud de slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mi'i phyag srol jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha las byung ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa de nyid do/ /'di dag byang sa dang / sdom pa nyi shu pa nas bshad pa'i don/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭi kar zhib tu bshad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sbyor ba'i/ dngos gzhi'i/ rjes kyi cho ga'i khyad par/ dgag pa'i bslab bya/ ltung ba'i khyad par/ phyir bcos kyi khyad par dang lnga'o/ /dang po la/ dbu sems gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar/ mchod pa/ skyabs 'gro/ sdig bshags/ rjes su yi rang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/ dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun rgyas par byed dgos te/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la mtshams med pa'i las byas pa sogs sdig sgrib shas che ba'i gang zag kyang sdom pa'i rten du rung la/

de dag gi las sgrib rags pa dag pa'i phyir du spyir yan lag bdun pa bye brag tu sdig bshags gtso bor dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang / ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni/ /grang dro kun tu skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin dbu ma'i sems bskyed kyang / /sdig pa yod med kun la skye/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal ci nus mchod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag bsdus pa tsam mdzad/ de ltar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'di yi lugs la/ byang sdom dngos su skye ba'i rten du mtshams med sogs byas pa'i sdig ldan mi rung bas bshags pa sogs gtso bor dngos su byed mi dgos pa'i phyir/ las sgrib shas che ba'i gang zag byang sdom dngos su skye ba'i rten du mi rung ste/ de dngos su skye ba'i rten du rigs bdun gang rung dang ldan pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang / ji ltar 'bras kyi sa bon ni/ /grang ba'i yul du mi skye ba/ /de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang / /sems bskyed sdig can la mi skye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbu sems gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang ste gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa khyad par can dang ldan pas smon 'jug gnyis po cho ga'i sgo nas lhan gcig tu len par bzhed de/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes pa 'di lan gsum du brjod pas byang sdom skye bar 'dod pa'i phyir/

de yang tshigs su bcad pa dang pos/ sdom pa gang la blang ba'i rten dkon mchog gsum bstan/ gnyis pas sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis smon 'jug gi sdom pa cho ga'i sgo nas blangs te bslab bya la slob tshul gyi dpe bstan/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis smon pa sems bskyed/ de nas gnyis kyis 'jug pa sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga bstan par bzhed do/ /de ltar yang / ci ste sems can thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon 'jog 'dod na/ /cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yi/ /dbu ma pa yi gzhung bzhin gyis/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por so thar rigs bdun gang rung gi sdom pa len/ de nas smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blangs nas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la mkhas par slob/ phyis 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len par bzhed do/ /de ltar yang / des na sems tsam pa yi lugs/ /gal te sems bskyed de 'dod na/ /thog mar so sor thar pa longs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod slobs/ /dad cing sgrub par nus gyur na/ /phyi nas sems bskyed sdom pa longs/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la/ dbu sems gnyis las/ dang po la/ rang dang gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsol tsam mdzad pa yin no/ /byang sdom blangs pa'i gang zag des de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi drung du thal mo sbyar zhing gus pa dang bcas te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mkhyen cing dgongs par mdzad du gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i drung du byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par nod pa lags te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas nod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la dpang du gyur par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum gyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis mkhyen cing dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod par byed do/ /bzhi pa la/ dbu sems gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung bzhi spong ba dang / rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i smon sems mi 'dor ba'i bslab bya la slob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa nyi shu pa nas bshad pa ltar/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi dang / yan lag gi ltung ba bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi spong ba la bslab dgos so/ /lnga pa la/ dbu sems gnyis las/ dang po ni/ smon sems dor ba'i dbang gis byang sdom las nyams na cho ga'i sgo nas slar gso bar byed/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba gang yang rung ba gcig byung na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba btab nas rmi lam du bshags pa byed par bshad de/ bslab btus las/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying po'i/ /mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya/ /zhes so/ /byang sems kyi bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i ltung ba phra mo rnams ni nyin mtshan dus drug tu phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa'i sgo nas bshags par bya ste/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing / /rgyal dang byang chub sems ldan pas/ /ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun dkris chen pos rtsa ltung spyad na sdom pa slar len/ 'bring gis spyad na gang zag gsum gyi drung du bshags/ kun dkris chung ngus spyad na sdom ldan gyi gang zag gcig gi drung du bshags dgos/

yan lag gi ltung ba spyad na rang sems dpang por byas nas bshags pa byed pa yin te/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /nyon mongs mi mongs bdag sems bzhin/ /zhes so/ /des na lugs gnyis la/ gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag ji ltar len pa'i cho ga dgag pa'i bslab bya/ ltung ba phyir bcos rnams la mi 'dra ba so sor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbu ma pa lta ba bzang zhing thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis de dang mthun par cho ga gu yangs pa dang / sems tsam pa dbu ma pa la ltos te lta spyod dman pa'i stobs kyis de dang mthun par cho ga gu dog pa'i rnam gzhag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / de'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams su bkral ba yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ /dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis/ /de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas/ /cho ga yang ni tha dad yod/ /ltung ba dang ni phyir bcos dang / /bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa/ sngags sdom thob par byed pa'i rgyu la/ gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag ji ltar len pa dbang bskur gyi cho ga dang gsum/ dang po la spyir bstan pa dang / de nyid bcu bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i dam tshig ma nyams shing dbang bskur ba'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga phyin ci ma log par shes pa/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrigs te sku bzhi'i sa bon 'debs nus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung la gces spras su mdzad pa'i bla ma'i drung du len dgos te/ ji skad du/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang / /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen cing /

/sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang / /de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa yi sbyor ba shes/ /rab tu dang zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu/ cho ga'i de nyid bcu/ rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba'i de nyid bcu'o/ /dang po ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang / lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /sngags dang rdul mtshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin mchog /phyag rgya stangs stabs gdan dang ni/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg mchod pa dang / /las la sbyar dang slar bsdu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma yongs bzung gi rgyud las/ gnas dang dus dang lha dang sngags/ /bgrang 'phreng phyag rgya sbyin sreg dang / mchod dang dbang bskur rab gnas kyi/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ skal dman rim 'jug pa/ skal ldan cig car ba/ slob ma'i grang nges la dogs pa gcad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rigs bdun gang rung gi sdom pa skye rung gi mi'i 'gro ba gcig dgos te/ 'di dag gi rigs brgyad la sogs pa'i spyod pa dang grub mtha' bzhi la sogs pa'i lta ba la rim gyis bslab dgos pa'i phyir/ ji ltar slob na/ thog mar 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i sgo nas tshe 'di 'ba' zhig la zhen pa'i blo bzlog ste/ phyi ma lha mi'i phun tshogs thob pa dang byang chub kyi sa bon bzhag pa'i phyir du bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa tsam la slob par byed/

de'i rjes su 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i sgo nas 'khor ba spangs pa'i byang chub bsgrub phyir du so thar rigs bdun gang rung la sbyor bar byed/ de'i rjes su sems bskyed pa'i phan yon/ ma bskyed pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa'i sgo nas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed len du bcug ste spyod pa rim can du slob/ de nas grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhi la rim can du bslabs te/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam la brten nas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed dgos pa yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ skal dman sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai yi rdo rje brtsam/ /slob mas gus pas blangs nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skye ba snga mar spyod pa dang lta ba rim gyis sbyangs shing bla med kyi dam tshig ma nyams par yod pa/ tshe 'di la ltos te skal ldan cig car bar snang ba yang yod la/ gang zag 'ga' zhig ni mthu nus dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur ba tsam gyis smin cing grol bar 'gyur ba da lta tha mal par snang ba'i skal ldan cig car ba yang yod/ /'di la gang zag gi rigs nges pa med de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyud 'chad pa'i 'khor du lha dang mi lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'gro ba sna tshogs yod par bshad pa dang / brtag gnyis las/ gdol pa snyug ma mkhan la sogs/ /gsad don don du sems pa po/ /de rnams kyai rdo rje shes nas/

/'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /gsum pa la/ gzhan gyi don log rtog dgag pa/ rang lugs ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul/ de las 'phros pa'i dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ kha cig rgyud sde bzhi po gang la yang dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob ma la grangs nges pa can mi dgos te/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang bskur ba sogs grangs nges med pa'i dbang bskur mang du gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ mi 'thad de/ da ltar gyi gnas skabs su/ so so'i skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa sprul nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur rigs par thal/ bdag med mas rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang da ltar gyi gnas skabs su/ tshur shog gi bsnyen rdzogs byed rigs par thal/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dge slong dag tshur shog la tshangs par spyod pa spyod cig ces pa'i tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ spyod rgyud du/ slob ma grangs nges med par bshad de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos par bzung bar bya/ /zhes dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde lhag ma gsum la dmigs bsal du slob ma'i grangs nges pa can bzhed pa yin te/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur la/ /slob ma grangs nges med par gsungs/ /lhag ma dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi/ /slob ma la ni grangs nges yod/ /'di ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ /mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga'am yang na bdun dag gam/

/nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur slob ma bzung / /de bas lhag pa'i slob ma ni/ /yongs su bzung bar mi shes so/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la kha cig gsang sngags bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga las lhag pa la dbang bskur na gsang sngags kyi sdom pa 'chags pa med de/ dus gcig tu bsgrub bya gsum las lhag pa la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog na mi 'chags pa gang zhig de gnyis mgo mtshungs su bshad pa'i phyir te/ des na nyan thos theg pa ni/ /nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang / /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la/ /gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo / /blun po snying phod can gyis kyang / /'dul ba'i cho ga brgal ma nus/ /gsang sngags cho ga thams cad la/ /blun po rnams kyis rang bzor spyod/ /dper na rab byung gang zag ni/ /gsum las mang ba 'jug mi nus/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na/ /grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa gzhan dag na re/ de mi 'thad de/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma bzhi la dus gcig tu dbang bskur ba la gsang sngags kyi sdom pa 'chags pa mi srid par thal/ rtags sngar gyi de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lnga las lhag pa yan chad la yang mi 'chags par thal lo/ /gzhan yang da ltar gyi cho gas gang zag bzhi la dus gcig tu bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba srid par thal/ da ltar gyi dbang bskur la brten nas gang zag bzhi la dus gcig tu sngags sdom thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa gnyis po mgo mtshungs pa'i steng du khas blangs/ rtsa ba'i rtags grub ste/ spyod pa'i rgyud la de ltar du yod pa'i phyir/ des na nyes med phun tshogs kyi dbang du byas na slob ma grangs gcig dang gsum la sogs pa kha yar ba dang nyi shu rtsa lnga tshun chad kyi grangs nges pa can dgos la/ skye la nyes byas kyi dbang du byas na nyi shu rtsa lnga las lhag pa la yang sdom pa 'chags pa'i skabs yod de/

nyi shu rtsa lnga las lhag pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyis sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga lhag chad nor ba'i skyon med par brda sprad pa las dbang gi don go ba yod pa'i phyir/ dper na gang zag bzhi dang drug la dbang bskur ba bzhin no/ /de ltar lugs gnyis yod pa las phyi ma 'di nyid 'thad dam snyam mo/ /gsum pa la/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i cho ga de ltar dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa/ sngags sdom thob pa'i sa mtshams la dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / dogs pa dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ye shes kyi/ sprul pa'i/ ting nge 'dzin gyi/ rdul mtshon gyi/ ras bris kyi/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang drug dang po ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'khor rnams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur ba'i ched du ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dper na/ ston pas rgyal po zla ba bzang po dus kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa thob pa'i 'phags pa dang so so skye bo las dag rnams kyi don du sprul pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa sprul pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/ rje btsun bdag med mas dpal ldan chos skyong la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas sa drug gi rtogs pa mngon du mdzad par bshad pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob pa'i so so skye bo rdo rje slob dpon dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag gis lus ngag gi byed pa med par ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs pa'o/ /dper na/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba la ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/

/des na dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor du bshad cing der lus ngag gi byed pa med par ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod ces bya'o/ /deng sang bla ma kha cig gsang ba 'dus pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchod chog phyi rol tshogs kyi yan lag gyer dbyangs kyi tshul gyis 'don pa la bsam gtan sgrub mchod kyi ming btags pa ni/ bsam gtan sgrub mchod kyi go ba cung zad kyang ma chags par zad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ thig tshon byin gyis brlabs te slob ma ma smin pa smin par bya ba'i phyir du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs pa'o/ /'di dag skal dman rim 'jug pa'i gdul bya dang por ma smin pa smin par bya ba'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs te/ gdul bya de dag dang por ma smin pa smin par byed pa la dbang gis mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan dgos shing / de la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa bdun ni/ bsnyen pa'i cho ga sa'i cho ga sta gon/ bris shing rgyan bkram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ mjug gi bya ba dang bdun la mngon rtogs ljon shing du bshad/ bsnyen pa la/ rab mtshan ma'i/ 'bring dus kyi/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rab kyi rab yi dam lhas dngos su gnang ba thob pa/ rab kyi 'bring rmi lam du gnang ba thob pa/ rab kyi tha ma rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la 'jog thub pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ zla drug sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan yang de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi de bzhin khri/ /zhes so/ /gzhung 'dir/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/

/dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/ /gzhan gyis smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces dang / nā ro pas/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel par/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun po 'di dag ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par spangs nas gzhan ras bris la sogs par dbang bskur bar bya ba ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ ras kyi gzhi rnam par dag pa la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par bris nas rab gnas tshul bzhin du byas pa lta bu'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni/ /thig las tshon dgye'i rim par bstan/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dzā ya se nas/ rdul tshon bri bar ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /nges par bcom ldan he ru ka /phyag rgya'i gzugs dang bcas par bri/ /zhes so/ /drug pa ni/ rang lus la gdod ma nas grub pa'i rtsa khams lha'i rang bzhin can du gnas pa la 'dod de/ rdo rje dril bu pas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la kha cig da lta dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdul tshon nges par dgos te/ 'dir rdul tshon las gzhan du dbang bskur ba bkag pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad de/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung las ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dngos su bshad pa dang / rje btsun rtse mos dbang chur/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs 'di ni/ bde mchog a bhi dha na la brten nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje la sogs pas gsungs la/ deng sang rgya gar na yang cho ga phal cher 'di la byed cing bla ma gong ma rnams kyang skabs skabs su phyag len 'di la mdzad pas lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / rje btsun grags pas gzhan phan spyi chings su/

sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbye ba gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas/ sngar rgyud ma smin pa gsar du smin par byed pa la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dgos shing / dkyil 'khor gcig tu smin byed kyi dbang thob nas dkyil 'khor gzhan du dbang bskur ba la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pas kyang rung ba yin no/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yang na/ bstan bcos 'dir bshad pa ni/ skal dman rim 'jug pa'i gang zag dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan gyis smin dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin la/ ras bris la sogs par dbang bskur bar bshad pa ni/ las dang po pa yin yang skal ldan cig car ba'i dbang du byas nas gsungs par bshad kyang legs bshad du 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi bzung / /gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya/ /nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa'i/ sta gon gyi/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum/ dang po la/ sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ sa bzung ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sa phyogs der dkyil 'khor byar rung mi rung yid kyis brtag par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ snang ba la bslang ba dang / mi snang ba la bslang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sa de'i bdag por gyur pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa la slong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa phyogs de bdag tu bzung ba'i mi ma yin la gtor ma byin pa'i sgo nas slong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ swa bha wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyong ba dang las kyis sa de'i skyon sbyong bar byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa phyogs der srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gzhir byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon dang /

bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dbang bskur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la dbang du bya ba'i phyir du sa'i lha mo la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i dus su lha rnams 'byon par snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir du lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgoms nas bzlas pa mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa byas nas sngags dang phyag rgya'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor btegs te nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /gsum pa la/ rnam rgyal dang / las kyi bum pa sta gon bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i dus su bum pa'i chu nus ldan du bya ba'i phyir du bum par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas bzlas pa dang mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes su rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren bsal ba'i phyir du bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la sogs pa'i khro bo nus ldan gang yang rung ba gcig bskyed/ bzlas pa mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes su 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob ma gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa dang dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa dang dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa bsrung ba'i phyir du sta gon gyi chos bcu bzhi lag len ltar du byed pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan bkram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ thig gi dbye ba/ nges tshig thig gdab tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ spyir thig tsam la dbye na/ thig gi sgras ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i phyir du nam mkhar gdab dgos pa ye shes kyi thig

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed pa'i rten gzhi mtshon pa'i phyir du sa la gdab dgos pa las kyi thig gnyis yod/ rnam grangs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mi 'gyur ba chos nyid kyi thig rig pa ye shes kyi thig byin rlabs cho 'phrul gyi thig gdab pa srad bu'i thig dang bzhi/ 'di la gnam thig dang / sa thig gnyis/ de dag la ye shes kyi thig dang / las kyi thig tu 'jog sa thig la/ skam thig dang / gsher thig gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi cha che chung gzhan du mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir du gdab par bya ba yin pas na thig ces bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dang por dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i tshe gdab par bya ba'i thig chen brgyad de/ tshangs thig gnyis/ zur thig gnyis/ rtsa thig bzhi rnams so/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar nub dang / lho byang gi gzhung la gdab pa'i thig ni tshangs thig ces bya ste/ tshangs pa chen po dang chos mtshungs rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar mtshungs snyam na/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten mes zhig nas chags pa'i tshe bcud kyi sems can gyi thog mar tshangs pa chen po chags pa dang 'dra bar thig 'di yang dang por gdab par bya ba yin pa dang / tshangs pa chen po 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ba ltar tshangs thig la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi cha shas che chung gi skyon sel nus pa dang / tshangs pa chen po bsam gtan dang po'i lha'i gtso bo yin pa ltar thig 'di yang thig rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo yin pas chos mthun no/ /zur thig gnyis ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi dang phyogs bzhi cha che chung med par mnyam par rtogs pa'i ched du yin no/ /rtsa ba'i thig bzhi ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i shar gyi nang mtha' nas nub kyi nang mtha'i bar la cha chen brgyad yod pa rtogs pa'i phyir du yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ thig ji ltar gdab pa bzhin lag len la mkhas pa'i gang zag gis tshon gyis bshad tshod dang mthun par bri ba'o/

/gsum pa la/ sku phyag rgya chen po bri ba/ gsung yig 'bru bri ba/ thugs phyag mtshan bri ba'o/ /de ltar ma nus na lha'i mtshon byed tshon gyi mtshan ma tsam bri ba'o/ /rgyan bkram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir du gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa dang / mchod pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bdag mdun tha dad du sgrub tshul dang / tha mi dad du sgrub tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor so sor bsgoms nas mi bsre bar tha dad du gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas mdun bskyed sgom pa'i dus su/ dkyil 'khor bdun bsres kyi tshul gyis bsgrub pa yin te/ dang por bdag bskyed kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa bsgoms nas de nyid la ye shes pa 'jug de'i rjes su mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgoms nas bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed tha mi dad du bsre/ slar yang gtso bo yab yum gyi mngal du rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed/ de nyid phyi rol du spros nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang dbyer med du bsre/ de'i rjes su sta gon gyi dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis bsres nas thams cad la thun mong du ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te bstim pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la bdun bsres byed pa ni 'phags pa rin po che'i dkyil chog tu bshad cing / dbang chu chen mo ltar na/ gtso bo la drug bsres/ 'khor la lnga bsres/ gzhal yas khang la bdun bsres mdzad par bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pas mchod par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ slob ma la dbang ji ltar bskur ba'i grangs dang mthun par dang por slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis dbang len dgos te/

saṃ bhu ṭi las/ sngags kyi lam gyi rjes btsal ba/ /gang tshe mkhas pas dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mngon sum du/ /dkyil 'khor bde bar bzhengs nas su/ /blo dang ldan pas de bzhin blang / /rang byin brlab pa'i gnas thob nas/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i 'jigs pa yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis don dam las/ /sngags kyi lam ni de bzhin gsungs/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa la/ slob ma 'jug pa/ dbang bskur ba/ dbang gi rab dbye dang gsum/ dang po la/ phyi'i 'jug pa dang / nang gi 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du btang nas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed de/ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sgo nas yol ba'i phyi nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa/ dngos gzhi ye shes pa dbab pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la me tog phul te dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs slob ma la ston par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde so so nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi dbang lag len dang mthun par slob ma la skur bar byed pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ bya spyod kyi dbang dang lam gyi rim pa/ rnam 'byor rgyud kyi dbang dang lam gyi rim pa/ bla med kyi dbang dang lam gyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ smin byed dbang gi dbye ba dang / grol byed kyi lam nyams su len tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bya ba'i rgyud la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang gnyis yod par bshad/ spyod pa'i rgyud la/ de'i steng du rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang dang lnga yod par bshad de/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /zhes so/ /de yang bya ba'i rgyud du/ bya rgyud rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i phyir du chu dang cod pan gyi dbang /

rigs sngags bsgrub pa'i phyir du sngags kyi bzlas lung / bgegs 'joms pa'i phyir du byab khrus bsrung gsum/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir du bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sbyin par bshad de/ de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /slob dpon rnam par mkhas pa yis/ /de dag shes nas ci rigs spyad/ /slob dpon go 'phang rab bsgrub phyir/ /dang po yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /rigs sngags rnams ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/ /bgegs rnams 'joms par bya ba'i phyir/ /gsum pa yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byor ba thob bya'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas par de bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nyid kyis spyod pa'i rgyud la mtshon par bya ba yin te/ gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /las kyi cho ga rnams med pa/ /des ni spyi yi rgyu dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten/ /zhes gsang ba spyi rgyud las bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / dogs pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bya rgyud du mdun du bris sku la sogs pa lhar bsgom/ bdag nyid lhar sgom pa med par rje 'bangs lta bu'i sgo nas lam nyams su len par byed/ spyod pa'i rgyud du/ bdag nyid dang bris sku la sogs pa gnyis ka lhar sgom ye shes pa dgug gzhug med par grogs po lta bu'i nyams len mdzad pa yin te/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ bdag nyid lha'i bsnyems pa med pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa ni/ /bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so zhes dang / 'dir/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med/ /ces dang / bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum las/ /snang ba lha ru gsungs pa med/ /'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ /bris sku lha ru bsgoms nas kyang / /de las dngos grub len pa yin/ /des na dka' thub gtsang sbra yis/ /sangs rgyas mnyes nas dngos grub gnang /

/spyod pa'i rgyud du bris sku dang / /rang nyid gnyis ka lhar bsgoms nas/ /grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la kha cig bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa mi 'thad de/ bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i gtsug tor rnam rgyal la sogs pa la bdag bskyed yod par mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir zer na/ skyon med de/ bya rgyud rang rkang la bdag bskyed med par bzhed pa yin gyi bya rgyud kyi lha 'ga' zhig la bdag bskyed sbyar nas nyams su len du mi rung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ de yang bya rgyud rang rkang la bdag bskyed med pa'i don ni/ bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi la sogs pa bod du 'gyur ba'i bya rgyud sum brgya dang bdun cu don grangs tsam yod kyang de dag tu bdag bskyed dngos su ma gsungs pa la bzhed do/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi ni/ bya rgyud kyi lam gyi rnam gzhag spyir ston pa dpung bzangs/ dkyil 'khor sum brgya lnga bcu'i dbang gis rnam gzhag ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud/ lha'i bskyed chog gtso bor ston pa legs grub/ mtshan med stong nyid kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma dang bzhi'o/ /bya rgyud kyi lha la bdag bskyed sbyar nas nyams su blang du rung ba'i don ni/ bya rgyud kyi lha gcig nyid la rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len sbyar du rung ba la bzhed/ de yang cung zad bshad na/ bya rgyud kyi lha bya rgyud ltar du nyams su len pa/ spyod rgyud ltar du nyams su len pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud ltar du nyams su len pa/ bla med ltar du nyams su len pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bsgom par bya ba'i yi dam gyi lha de nyid mdun bskyed kyi tshul du sgom/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros rang gi lus la phog pas rnam smin gyi sha khrag dang sdig sgrib sogs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gnas pa'i ngang nas bzlas pa dang mchod bstod la sogs pa byas te dngos grub len pa lta bu'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid lha ru bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug sogs mi byed par bzlas pa mchod bstod byas te dngos grub len pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang nyid lhar bskyed ye shes pa bcug nas bzlas pa dang mchod bstod la sogs pa byas te dngos grub len pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa dang mchod bstod sogs byas te dngos grub len pa lta bu'o/ /de skad du yang / bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku mchod nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bskyed sgrub thabs gsungs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /de yi lugs bzhin mdzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ dbang dang / lam nyams su len tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga sngon du 'gro ba'i bum dbang yod kyi dbang gong ma gsum ni yod pa ma yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ phyir mi ldog pa bum pa'i dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar phye/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sogs sgom pa'i tshe dang por bdag nyid lhar bskyed/ de la ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya ba/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab/ gshegs gsol ma byas pa de srid du rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyams su len te/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor rgyud du phyi rol la/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen tsam byas nas kyang / /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid tha mal 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la/ dbang dang / lam nyams su len tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ dbang bzhir dbye ba/ de ltar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas bcu bzhir phye ba'o/

/dang po ni/ bla med la smin byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan te/ brtag gnyis las/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang ni rnam pa bzhi dag tu/ /rgyud 'di las ni rab tu bsgrags/ /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba zhes bya brjod/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa yin/ /de bzhin de ltar yang bzhi pa/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ smin byed kyi dbang la bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ smin byed kyi dbang bzhi bskur ba'i stobs kyis sbyang bya'i dri ma bzhi sbyong byed lam bzhis sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sku bzhi mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la nang tshan gyi sgo nas bcu bzhir yod de/ bum dbang dang / me tog gi phreng ba sbyin pa/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ste brgyad/ mtha' rten la lung bstan/ rjes gnang / dbugs dbyung gsum/ dbang gong ma gsum dang bcu bzhir 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ rigs kyi lhar nges me tog phreng / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming gi dbang / /bde gshegs lnga yi bdag nyid dbang / /brtul zhugs dang ni lung bstan nyid/ /rjes gnang dang ni dbugs dbyung dang / /phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon dbang / /bum pa las ni byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i mchog yin te/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes yin/ /bzhi pa de yang de ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ lha'i bskyed chog gi rim pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i dbye ba/ nyams len zab pa'i khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ yan lag bzhi/ yan lag drug gi sgo nas bskyed tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag

skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa sgrub pa'i yan lag ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /dam tshig pa bskyed tshul la yang / mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa/ rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed pa/ sa bon las bskyed pa/ skad cig gis bskyed pa dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i/ dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi/ mchod pa don yod grub pa'i/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go /gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ bskyed rim gyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs ljon shing las/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs sdom pa dang dam tshig ste bcu gcig go /dang po lnga ni/ snang ba thams cad dag pa lha'i rang bzhin du bsgom pa'i bskyed rim/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi zhen pa 'gog pa'i rdzogs rim/ dbang dus su thob pa'i mtshon byed dpe'i phyag chen gyi rgyun goms par byed pa'i lta ba/ bskyed rdzogs kyi brtan pa thob pa'i sgo nas myur du sa lam bgrod par byed pa'i thabs spyod pa/ 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas te myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs nye rgyus mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa lnga ni/ lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa/ bar chad sel byed gtor ma/ bsnyen pa kha skong ba'i thabs sbyin sreg sku gzugs byin gyis brlab pa'i rab gnas/ dman pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs las kyi cho gas rab 'byam mo/ /dam tshig la yang bsten pa'i/ mi 'bral ba'i/ bza' ba'i/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig rnams so/

/gnyis pa la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ nyams su len pa'i go rim mo/ /dang po la/ sbyang gzhi la/ sbyong byed lam la/ sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu la gtso bor bshad tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ltar na/ bskyed rim zhes pa'i bskyed pa ni/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten rim gyis 'chags pa yin la/ rim pa ni/ sbyang gzhi de'i gnyen por rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha'i tshogs blo yul du rim can du gsal bar byed pa'i nyams len no/ /rdzogs rim zhes pa'i rdzogs pa ni/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten me chu rlung gsum gyi rkyen gyis zhig pa yin la/ rim pa ni/ sbyang gzhi de'i gnyen por rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdus nas bde stong zung du 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su len pa'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ltar na/ bskyed rim ni/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor/ cho ga'i sgo nas rim gyis gsal btab ste zab gsal gnyis med kyi tshul gyis nyams su len pa'i nyams len no/ /rdzogs rim ni/ lus ngag yid gsum la khyab pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum rdzogs par gsal btab nas nyams su len pa'i nyams len no/ /gsum pa ni/ sems 'grel skor gsum pa ltar na/ bskyed rim ni thun mong gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir du rten dang brten pa rim gyis gsal btab ste nyams su len pa'i nyams len no/ /rdzogs rim ni/ mchog gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir du bde stong zung 'jug gi lam nyams su len pa'i nyams len no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sbyong ba dang / thun mong gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir du rten dang brten pa'i lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du blo yul du gsal btab nas zab gsal gnyis med kyi tshul du nyams su len pa'i nyams len ni/

bskyed rim gyi ngo bo yin zhing / dbye na/ phyi dang nang gi bskyed rim gnyis so/ /sbyang gzhi snod bcud 'jig rten zhig pa sbyong ba dang / mchog gi dngos grub la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir du rtsa thig rlung gsum ci rigs pa gsal btab nas bde stong zung 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su len pa'i nyams len ni rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo yin la/ dbye na/ gtum mo'i lam/ pho nya'i/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam dang gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ dang po bskyed rim la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i tshul gyis legs par sbyangs te de'i rjes su rdzogs rim nyams su len dgos te/ gsang 'dus las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul bcu bzhi yod/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs lta bu la sbyar na/ bskyed rim nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ las dang po pa/ bde ba cung zad skyes pa/ bde stong gi nyams skyes pa/ bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ yan lag bzhi pa dang / drug pa'i mngon rtogs so/ /dang po la/ mnyam sbyor dang / mi mnyam sbyor gyi mngon rtogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las sku mdog sngon por bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams thig le 'gros dang / sa bon 'gros kyi tshul gyis mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mi mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las sku mdog sngon por bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams thig le 'gros dang / sa bon 'gros kyi tshul gyis mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis so/

/gnyis pa la/ mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mi mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las sku mdog dkar por bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams sa bon 'gros dang / lha mo 'gros kyi tshul gyis bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las sku mdog dkar por bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams sa bon 'gros dang / lha mo 'gros kyi tshul gyis bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis so/ /de ltar na mngon par rtogs pa brgyad do/ /de yang mnyam sbyor ni/ ā li dang / kā li las zla ba gru gsum kha sbyor gyi tshul du bskyed pa yin la/ mi mnyam sbyor ni ā li las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du kā li las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa bde ba cung zad skyes pa'i gang zag gis bsgom par bya ba'i mngon rtogs la yan lag bzhi pa dang / drug pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtso bo ā li kā li la ltos med kyi mi mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams thig le 'gros dang / sa bon 'gros kyi tshul gyis mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum ā li kā li la ltos med kyi mi mnyam sbyor mngon byang lnga las bskyed/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams sa bon 'gros dang / lha mo thig le 'gros kyi tshul gyis bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gnyis te de ltar mngon par rtogs pa bzhi'o/ /gsum pa bde stong gi nyams skyes pa'i gang zag gis bsgom par bya ba'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed/ mngal nas 'khor gyi lha mo rnams dbyung ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa'i gang zag gis bsgom par bya ba'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/

gtso bo yab yum skad cig gis gsal btab mngal nas 'khor gyi lha mo rnams spro ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /de ltar mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di dag thams cad sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i sgo nas dag pa lha'i rang bzhin du snang ba lha so so'i dag pa/ de dag kyang rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul yin par shes pa rang rig pa'i dag pa/ de dag kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i spros bral la rag las pa de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ste/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid can du nyams su len par byed pa ni rgyu sde 'og ma rnams las ches mchog tu gyur ba'i khyad chos yin te/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du ni/ /dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /'di yi lung rigs man ngag rnams/ /bla ma'i zhal la legs par dris/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang ba 'di/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyi/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa/ /de tshe dam pa rigs brgya la/ /sogs pa'i dbye ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na/ rgyud sde bzhi la dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lam gyi bab nyams su len tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi yan lag thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len dgos te/ de ltar nyams su blangs na rgyud sde rang rang nas bshad pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par nus pa'i phyir/ ji skad du yang / des na rgyud sde bzhi po yi/ /dbang dang lam gyi dbye ba la/ /mi 'dra'i dbye ba rnam bzhi yod/ /rang rang cho ga bzhin byas na/ /de nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor dang mtshan med stong nyid kyi rnal 'byor tsam yod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi tha snyad yod pa ma yin te/

dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis rnal 'byor bla med kho na'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang / bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum kar/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim gnyis med/ /gal te yod na de dag kyang / /rnal 'byor chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa la dbang ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs dang / bskur ba'i phan yon gnyis/ dang po ni/ dam pa dang po las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba med/ /ces dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /mi zad dmyal ba chen po 'gro/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang / /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /sgrub kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /dbang bskur med pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du yang / /de la dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /ces dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ spyi'i phan yon dang / bye brag bla med kyi phan yon gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang 'dus 'bum pa las/ bskal pa sa yar byas pa yi/ /sngon du yod pa'i sdig pa kun/ /de kun 'dzad par 'gyur ba ste/ dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas so/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ gsang sngags mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab byung mthong ba na/ /deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las/ /rnam grol bzang por 'gyur bar gnas/ /zhes dang / he ru ka mngon byung las/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mthong nas ni/

/cung zad de ni mi 'grub med/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nag po pa'i dkyil chog las/ dbang bskur 'di dag thob nas ni/ slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /mtshams med pa dang sdig can yang / /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma bsgoms par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'dir yang / des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin/ /dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pas/ /rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes dang / sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na/ /de ni tshe 'di 'am bar do'am/ /skye ba bcu drug tshun chad nas/ /'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la/ ma thob pa la thob par 'dod pa dgag pa dang / thob pa la ma thob par 'dod pa dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha cig gsang sngags bla med kyi sta gon gyi 'jug pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs su sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa yin te/ der rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa'i rjes su rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir zer/ mi 'thad de/ slob ma ma smin pa smin pa'i phyir du dbang bskur ba don med par 'gyur te/ dbang gi dngos gzhi la brten nas sngags sdom sngar med gsar du thob pa'i gang zag gis bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len pa la 'jug pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gzhan yang sta gon gyi skabs su bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len par khas blangs pa tsam gyis bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa thob par 'gyur te/

sta gon gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs pa tsam gyis sngags kyi sdom pa thob par nus pa'i phyir/ gsol bzhi'i cho ga la ltos med du sbyor ba'i gnas skabs su dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa yod par thal/ dbang gi dngos gzhi la ltos med du/ sta gon gyi gnas skabs su sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi sbyor ba'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs pa dgos med du thal/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i snga logs su bla med kyi dam tshig dang sngags sdom rdzogs par thob zin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa ni/ kha cig spyir sngags sdom la/ khas blangs las thob pa'i sngags sdom/ cho ga las thob pa'i sngags sdom gnyis yod cing / dang po ni/ sta gon gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs pa las thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa la yang / bskyed rim gyi sdom pa dang rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gnyis yod/ de yang bskyed rim gyi sdom pa ni bum dbang rdzogs rjes su thob/ rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa ni dbang bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i rjes su thob/ des na bla med kyi sngags sdom dbang bzhi ka rdzogs pa'i rjes su thob dgos te/ mchog dbang gsum bskur ba la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa sngar med gsar du skye dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung ngo / /'o na rgyu dus kyi dbang la brten nas rgyu dus kyi sngags sdom/ lam dus kyi dbang la brten nas lam dus kyi sngags sdom/ 'bras dus kyi dbang la brten nas 'bras dus kyi sngags sdom tha dad pa sngar med gsar du skye ba yod par 'gyur te/ sta gon gyi skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba las khas blangs kyi sdom pa/ bum dbang la brten nas bskyed rim gyi sdom pa/ mchog dbang gsum la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa tha dad pa sngar med gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la brten nas mi bskyod pa'i sngags sdom/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang la brten nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sngags sdom sogs rigs pa'i dbang lnga la brten nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa tha dad pa sngar med gsar du skye ba yod par 'gyur ba dang / gsang dbang la brten nas gtum mo'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba'i sngags sdom/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la brten nas pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba'i sngags sdom/ dbang bzhi pa la brten nas rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam bsgom pa la dbang ba'i sngags sdom tha dad pa sngar med gsar du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / dge slong gi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i gsol bzhi'i cho ga la brten nas dge slong gi sdom pa dngos gzhi skyes pa'i rjes su gdams ngag bcu gcig brjod pa la brten nas/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i cha shas 'ga' zhig sngar med gsar du skye ba yod pa la sogs pa'i gnod byed shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khyad par spyir bstan pa dang / de dag thob pa'i sa mtshams dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ phar phyin theg pa las mchog tu gyur pa'i gsang sngags kyi spyod pa khyad par can 'ga' zhig nyams su len par khas blangs shing dam bcas pa ltar tshul bzhin du srung ba'i nyams len no/ /de la dbye na/ thun mong ma yin pa skyabs 'gro'i dam tshig bya rgyud kyi lam gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig nyams su len pa'i dam tshig khas blangs tsam gyis thob pa'i dam tshig cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i dam tshig dang bzhi/ 'di la bskyed rim gyi dam tshig dang / rdzogs rim gyi+i dam tshig gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang yi dam dkon mchog gsum dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin can du bsgoms nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yul de nyid la skyabs su 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig go
