/gnyis pa ni/ bla ma'i drung du lung nod de bsnyung gnas sogs nyams su len pa'i dam tshig dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas dam tshig gsum bkod sogs nas bshad pa'i lam gyi cha shas nyams su len pa'i dam tshig ste/ ji skad du/ bya ba'i rgyud la rnam gsum yod/ /don yod zhags sogs 'ga' zhig tu/ /dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang / /bsnyung gnas la sogs byed nus na/ /gang zag kun gyis sgrub par gsungs/ /dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa/ /'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas ni/ /'phrin las 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /cho ga shes nas sgrub par gnang / /legs par grub pa yan chad du/ /rang gi dbang bskur ma thob na/ /sems bskyed thob kyang gsang sngags bkag /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ sta gon nam 'jug pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs pa'i gang zag ste/ rje btsun gyis dga' ston springs yig tu tshogs gsog pa'i skabs su/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum byas pas rdo rje theg pa'i sta gon dang / yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams sor chud pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim gyi dam tshig ni bum dbang gi dngos gzhi la brten nas thob pa'i sngags sdom mo/ /rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig ni mchog dbang gsum la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi lam nyams su len par khas blangs pa ltar bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /de yang rje btsun rtse mos/ saṃ pu ṭi'i 'grel par/ spyir theg pa chen po'i sdom pa la sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang / bskyed rim gyi sdom pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gsum du gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa ni rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig la sdom pa'i ming gis btags pa yin te/ dper na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang gtor ma'i dbang bskur la dbang gis ming btags pa bzhin no/

/des na dam tshig dang sdom pa la spyi bye brag gi khyad par yod de/ sdom pa la dam tshig gis khyab kyang dam tshig la sdom pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ dper na sdom pa la tshul khrims kyis khyab kyang tshul khrims la sdom pas ma khyab pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde rang rang gi dbang gi dngos gzhi la brten nas thob pa'i 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i sdom pa'o/ /dbye na rgyud sde bzhi'i sngags sdom bzhi yod/ gnyis pa thob tshul dngos la dam tshig gi thob tshul dang / sngags sdom gyi thob tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir gsang sngags kyi dam tshig tsam thob pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi la ltos mi dgos te/ dbang bskur ma thob pa'i snga rol du yang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i dam tshig dang bya rgyud kyi lam gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig nyams su len pa'i dam tshig rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig thob pa yod pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig ni dbang gi dngos gzhi la nges par ltos dgos te/ bla med kyi bum dbang rdzogs rjes su bskyed rim gyi dam tshig mchog dbang rdzogs rjes su rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig thob dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud sde rang rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs par thob ma thag tu rgyud sde de dang de'i sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa yin te/ rgyud sde rang rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs pa de'i tshe rgyud sde de dang de'i dbang bskur rab gnas/ rgyun 'chad rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba spong ba'i sdom pa'i dngos gzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rgyud sde bzhi'i thob tshul bzhi yod pa las/ dang po bya rgyud kyi sngags sdom ni/ bya rgyud rang lugs kyi chu dang cod pan gyi dbang rdzogs pa'i rjes su thob ste/

des dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ spyod rgyud rang lugs kyi ming dbang rdzogs rjes su thob/ gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud rang lugs kyi bum dbang rdzogs rjes su thob ste/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ bum dbang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs pa'i rjes su sngags sdom rdzogs par thob ste/ der rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag gi ltung ba dgu rdzogs par spong ba'i sngags sdom gyi dngos gzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir te/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang yan lag gi ltung ba dgu spong ba'i dam tshig ni bum dbang gi dam tshig tu bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de ltar thob ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su rdo rje thugs kyi/ dril bu gsung gi phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gsum dang ldan pa'i sngags sdom cho ga'i sgo nas sbyin zhing sbyin pa ltar du thob pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rgyud sde rang rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs pa'i rjes su rgyud sde de dang de'i sngags sdom thob dgos pa mi 'thad de/ bya spyod gnyis la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang med pa'i phyir te/ bum dbang yongs su rdzogs pa med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / bla med kyi bum dbang gi rjes su mchog dbang gsum bskur ba don med par 'gyur te/ bum dbang rdzogs rjes su bla med kyi sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ dper na bya spyod gnyis su rgyud sde gong ma ltar gyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang med kyang bya spyod rang lugs la ltos pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yod de/ de gnyis kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i tshe de gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba rab tu gnas pa rgyud 'chad pa sogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

de skad du yang / dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs/ /slob dpon gyi ni 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /bla na med pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i las/ /nyid yin gzhan gyis byar mi rung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bya spyod gnyis su rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yod pa lung gis kyang grub ste/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ slob dpon go 'phang rab bsgrub phyir/ /dang po yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ thal ba gnyis pa'i skyon med de/ bum dbang gi rjes su mchog dbang gsum bskur ba ni gdul bya rdzogs rim bstan pa'i snod du rung ba'i ched yin gyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob pa'i ched ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ gsol bzhi'i cho ga la brten nas dge slong gi sdom pa thob zin pa la bslab pa shes nas bsrung ba'i phyir du gdams ngag bcu gcig brjod pa bzhin no/ /gzhan du na rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rjes su lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba don med par 'gyur te/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi dus su sngags sdom rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gal te bla med kyi bum dbang tsam rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag chos can/ bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka ston pa la dbang bar thal/ bla med kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ljon shing las/ mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig po de dag rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i las su gsungs pa'i phyir snyam na/ bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing bla med kyi bsnyen pa cung zad kyang ma byas pa'i gang zag chos can/ bla med kyi dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas sogs la dbang bar thal/ bla med kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dbang bskur rab gnas la sogs pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i las su gsungs pa'i phyir/

khyab pa rnams rim bzhin khas/ de dag gis ni sdom gsum ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thob bya sdom gsum gyi rang bzhin la/ sdom gsum so so'i rnam gzhag dang / gnas gtong gi dus la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ so thar/ byang sems/ sngags sdom dang gsum/ dang po la/ grub mtha'i dbye ba spyir brjod pa/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa/ rang lugs bzhag pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i/ sems tsam pa'i/ dbu ma pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang / dus kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang / khyad chos bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i gzugs can du 'dod de/ mdzod las/ dang po'i rnam rig rnam rig min/ /so so thar dang bya ba'i lam/ /zhes dang / gcig rnam gnyis so de dag kyang / /byed na dge ba bdun rnam gnyis/ /zhes pa'i rang 'grel du/ yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba'i tshul khrims ni rnam par rig byed la rag las pa'i phyir las kyi lam gzugs can bdun ni gdon mi za bar rnam par rig byed dang rig byed ma yin pa gnyis ka yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ rig byed dang / rig byed ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lus kyi rnam par rig byed dang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun slong gzhan la rig par byed pa'i lus kyi dbyibs la 'dod de/ mdzod du/ lus rnam rig byed dbyibs su 'dod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun slong gzhan la rig par byed pa'i ngag gi sgra la 'dod de/ mdzod du/ ngag rnam rig byed ni ngag sgra/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ sgrub byed/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs su 'dod de/ mdzod du/ g.yengs dang sems med pa yi yang / /dge dang mi dge rjes 'brel gang /

/'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa/ /de ni rnam rig byed min brjod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs yod de/ bstan yod thogs bcas kyi gzugs/ bstan med thogs bcas kyi gzugs/ bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs gsum gsungs pa dang / dri med kyi gzugs gsungs pa dang / rdzas la 'phel ba'i bsod nams bdun gsungs pa dang / rang gis dngos su ma byas kyang / gzhan byed du bcug pa las/ dge mi dge'i las lam rang la 'byung ba yod pa'i phyir/ mdzod du/ rnam gsum dri med gzugs gsungs dang / 'phel dang ma byas lam sogs phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa'i/ sdom min gyi/ bar ma'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs dang gsum ste/ mdzod du/ rnam rig min rnams gsum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyu'i khyad chos/ sa'i khyad chos/ ngo bo rgyu dang bcas pa'i khyad chos gsum gyi sgo nas shes par bya ba yin te/ mdzod las/ 'dod gtogs rnam rig min skad cig /phyin chad 'das pa'i 'byung las skye/ /zag bcas lus dang ngag gi las/ /rang gi 'byung ba dag rgyur byas/ /zag med gang du skyes pa'i yin/ /rnam rig byed min ma zin dang / /rgyu mthun las byung sems can ston/ /rgyu mthun zin pa'i 'byung las skye/ /ting 'dzin skyes 'byung ma zin dang / /rgyas 'byung tha dad min las skye/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dus kyi khyad par ni/ ji srid 'tsho'i sdom pa dang nyin zhag gi mtha' can gyi sdom pa gnyis su nges te/ rigs bdun ji srid 'tsho'i sdom pa dang bsnyen gnas ni nyin zhag gi mtha' can gyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mdzod du/ ji srid 'tsho dang nyin zhag tu/ /sdom pa yang dag blang bar bya/ /zhes dang / 'dir yang / nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas/ /dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yin/

/zhes dang / bsnyen gnas mtshan mo 'das pa na/ /gtong phyir 'di la 'bul mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa thob par byed pa'i rgyu la brten nas byung ba'i gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dang gtong rgyu ma byung ba'i sdom pa'i sa bon dang bcas pa la 'dod de/ las grub par/ gal te sems pa kho na lus kyi las su 'gyur na sems g.yengs pa dang sems med pa dag la sems pa de med na sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa gnyis ji ltar yod ce na/ sdom pa'i khyad par gyi bag chags la 'jog pa'i phyir sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa gnyis yod do/ /khyad par smos pa ni gang la sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa'i rnam par rig byed ma yin pa kun nas ldang bar btags pa'i sems pa khyad par du byas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa'i ngo bo shes pa kho nar 'dod de/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin shes par 'dod pa dang dge mi dge gzugs can khas mi len pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces dang / bzhi brgya par/ bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba/ /thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te/ /gang phyir sems de gtso bo'i phyir/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ gang gzugs dge ba dang mi dge bar smra ba de ni shākya'i sras ma yin shākya'i dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kha cig bstan bcos 'dir yang so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can yin gyi shes pa ma yin te/ gzugs can yin pa la sgrub byed yod shes pa yin pa la gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs can yin pa la sgrub byed yod de/ sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ /shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong / /zhes dang / nyan thos kyi lugs la rigs brgyad gzugs can du bshad cing rigs brgyad nyan thos kyi cho ga la brten nas thob dgos par bshad pa'i phyir/

shes pa yin pa la gnod byed yod de/ 'o na dge slong gi sdom pa de sems ma nyams kyi bar du rjes su 'brang bar thal/ de shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ shi 'phos pa'i dbang gis gtong ba'i phyir te/ theg chen so so thar yin yang / /zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir zer/ 'di dag rigs pa ma yin te/ theg pa dman pa'i lugs dang theg pa chen po'i lugs so sor ma phyed pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ so thar gyi sdom pa ngo bo gzugs can/ dus shi 'phos pa'i dbang gis gtong ba ni theg pa dman pa'i sde snod kyi lugs yin zhing so thar gyi sdom pa ngo bo shes pa dus shi 'phos pa'i dbang gis mi gtong ba ni theg pa chen po'i sde snod kyi lugs yin pa la sde snod kyi rnam dbye so sor ma shes pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang / des na so so thar pa yi/ /sdom pa shi yang yod do zhes/ /smra ba'i skyes bu de la ni/ /sde snod rnam dbye med par zad/ /ces pa'i rnam dbye'i tshig gi nus pa khong du ma chud par zad do/ /gzhan yang / theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom du gnas 'gyur ba med par thal/ theg dman so thar gyis nyer len byas pa las byung ba'i byang sdom gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir te/ so thar gyi sdom pa bem po dang byang sems kyi sdom pa shes pa gang zhig bem pos shes pa'i nyer len byed pa dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas bkag pa'i phyir te/ rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi/ /nyer len min pa'i phyir yang grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ rje btsun gyis rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du/ rgyud 'bum pa'i lung drangs nas sdom gsum gnas gyur ngo bo gcig tu bshad pa'i phyir dang / sngags kyi dbang bskur la brten nas sdom gsum dus cig car thob par bshad pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/

/bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sems kyi sdom pa bem por thal/ byang sems kyi nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims bem po yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun gyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims de yang mdor bsdu na rnam pa gsum ste nyes par spyod pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i tshul khrims so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa rigs bdun te dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge slob ma dang dge tshul dang dge tshul ma dang dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma'i tshul khrims gang yin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /gnyis pa la/ grub mtha'i sgo nas/ rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas/ cho ga'i sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ theg dman lugs kyi dang / theg chen lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dul mdzod gnyis las bshad pa ltar gyi so thar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa ltar gyi shes pa'i ngo bor gyur ba'i so thar ro/ /de yang theg dman lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa yin na/ theg dman gyi so thar gyi sdom pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ theg dman gyi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa'i gzugs can gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i so thar sdom pa rigs brgyad ni theg dman lugs kyi so thar sdom pa yin yang theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa ni 'dir shes par 'dod pa'i phyir/ dper na/ theg dman gyi lugs la 'gog snyoms ldan min 'du byed yin yang theg chen gyi lugs la 'gog snyoms shes par khas len dgos pa bzhin no/

/theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa yin na/ theg dman lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa yin mi dgos te/ theg dman gyi sdom pa ni shes pa yin la theg dman gyi lugs la sdom pa dang shes pa'i gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i phyir/ theg chen lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa yin na/ theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa yin pas ma khyab ste/ theg dman gyi rgyud kyi shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i so thar rigs brgyad theg chen lugs kyi so thar yin yang theg chen so thar ma yin pa'i phyir/ de theg chen lugs kyi so thar yin te/ theg chen rang lugs su khas blang bar bya ba'i so thar gyi sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa yin na/ theg chen rang lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa yin dgos te/ theg chen gyi rgyud kyi so thar gyi sdom pa ni theg chen rang lugs su ji lta ba bzhin du khas len pa'i phyir/ des na lugs dang rgyud gnyis ma 'dres pa so sor shes pa gnad du che'o/ /gnyis pa la/ theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa dang / theg chen so thar kyi sdom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don du theg dman gyi byang chub la dmigs pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /dbye na/ rigs brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /dbye na/ theg chen so thar rigs brgyad do/ /gsum pa la/ cho ga thun mong ma yin pa'i dang / cho ga thun mong ba'i theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa las bshad pa'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg chen so thar rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa byang sdom la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can la phan pa sgrub par byed pa'i bsam pas zin pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /gnyis pa la/

mtshan gzhi dang / cho ga'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gnyis tshan dang / gsum tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ smon pa sems bskyed 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga la brten nas byung ba'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jug pa sems bskyed 'bogs pa'i cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /de yang sems tsam pa ltar na 'di gnyis 'gal ba yin te cho ga las rim can du thob dgos pa'i phyir/ dbu ma pa ltar na/ 'gal ba ma yin te/ 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga gcig nyid las dus mnyam lhan cig tu skye bar bzhed pa'i phyir dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa gcig nyid gzhan don du byang chub thob par smon pa'i cha nas smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang / byang chub thob phyir du sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa'i bslab bya la slob pa'i cha nas 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang / smon pa sems bskyed don gcig pa dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang 'jug pa sems bskyed don gcig pa bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa yin te/ smon pa sems bskyed 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la smon pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang smon pa sems bskyed du 'jog 'jug pa sems bskyed 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga las thob pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la 'jug pa'i de gnyis su 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i/ dge ba chos sdud kyi/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de'i rgyud kyi sbyin sogs re re'ang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i sems bskyed lta bu/

gsum pa ni/ de'i rgyud kyi bsam sbyor gnyis ka'i sgo nas sems can la phan pa dngos su sgrub pa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o/ /'di gsum ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas so sor dbye ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ cho ga nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i/ cho ga thun mong ma yin pa'i/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga dang thun mong ba'i byang sdom dang gsum/ dang po ni/ theg chen so thar rigs brgyad lta bu yin te/ byang sdom dang theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa ni don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sdom pa de nyid gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i cha nas theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa dang gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa'i cha nas byang sdom du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbu sems gnyis kyi cho ga las thob pa'i smon 'jug gi sdom pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang las thob pa'i sngags sdom lta bu'o/ /gsum pa la/ smon pa sems bskyed cho gas skye mi skye dpyad pa dang / don dam sems bskyed cho gas skye mi skye dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bla ma shes bya kun rig la sogs pa ni/ smon pa sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas mi skye ste/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi blo yod na cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed mi dgos/ med na cho gas blangs kyang mi skye ba'i phyir dang / smon pa sems bskyed de byang sems kyi sdom pas ma zin pas bsod nams rgyun chags su mi 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub smon pa'i sems la ni/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang / /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed/ bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed pa la/ smon pa'i khyad par dang 'jug pa'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ smon pa'i sems/ smon pa sems bskyed/

smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya dang gsum/ dang po ni/ cho ga la ltos med du sems ma bskyed pa'i nyes dmigs/ bskyed pa'i phan yon mthong ba'i sgo nas gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i blo lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang sdom 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga la brten nas smon pa'i sems de nyid sdom pas zin pa'i sems bskyed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag gi bslab bya la tshul bzhin du slob par byed pa'o/ /des na spyod 'jug gi don ni/ sdom pas ma zin pa'i smon sems rkyang pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ 'jug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa sems bskyed/ 'jug pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya dang gsum/ dang po ni/ cho ga la ltos med du phar phyin drug gi bslab bya la slob pa'i sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa 'bogs par byed pa'i cho ga la brten nas 'jug pa'i sems de nyid sdom pas zin pa'i sems bskyed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag gi bslab bya phyin drug la tshul bzhin du slob par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ kha cig don dam sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba yod de/ dbang gi sta gon gyi skabs su/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems rdo rje lta bur bsgom pa'i sgo nas sems bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lam cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba yod pa'i phyir zer/ 'di la dam bca' mi 'thad pa dang / sgrub byed mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ don dam sems bskyed de rags pa brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed yin par thal/ cho ga'i sgo nas bskyed pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ de phra ba chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed ma yin par thal/ de cho ga la ltos med du chos nyid sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/

chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces dang / 'dir yang / don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /bsgom pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye/ /gal te cho gas skye na ni/ /brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed 'gyur/ /'di ni don dam chos nyid kyis/ /thob pa zhes bya'i sems bskyed yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub byed dang po la/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba yod par thal/ mngon byang lnga'i skabs su me long lta bu'i ye shes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu dang mnyam nyid ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur bsgoms nas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin na don dam sems bskyed yin dgos par thal/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam cho ga las skye ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis don dam sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas skye ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin na mtshon bya don gyi phyag rgya chen po yin pas khyab pa dang / spros bral stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pas khyab par thal lo/ /des na don dam sems bskyed ni sgom pa'i stobs kyis skye ba yin gyi cho ga'i stobs kyis skye ba ma yin te/ sbyor lam chos mchog la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des spros bral stong pa nyid rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis spros bral stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i tshe don dam sems bskyed rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i phyir te/ don dam sems bskyed de sa dang po'i rtogs pa thob ma thag tu mngon du 'gyur gyi/ de'i snga rol du mngon du 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ 'phags lam zag med rang rgyud la skyes pa'i stobs kyis zag med kyi sdom pa rang gi ngang gis mngon du 'gyur ba dang /

bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug rang rgyud la skyes pa'i stobs kyis bsam gtan gyi sdom pa rang gi ngang gis mngon du 'gyur ba yin gyi cho ga la ltos mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces dang / chos dang sems can rnams dang ni/ /de yi bya ba sangs rgyas nyid/ /mchog la sems mnyam rnyed pa'i phyir/ /de yis rab dga' khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / 'dir yang / don dam byang chub sems dang ni/ /zag pa med pa'i sdom pa dang / /bsam gtan gyi ni sdom pa sogs/ /ngang gis skye yi cho gas min/ /'di dag 'thad pa dang bcas pa/ /mdo dang bstan bcos kun las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang / byang chub sems 'grel las/ kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas len pa dang don dam sems bskyed gnas lugs kyi don sgom stobs kyis skye bar bshad pa yin te/ sems 'grel las/ bdag gi sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang ma grol ba rnams sgrol ba dang dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ba yin pas de'i phyir de'i rang bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sngags sdom gyi ngo bo ni/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong las/ rig pa 'dzin pa ni de dag kyang lha'i rnam par ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod pa yin pas 'di la 'gal ba ci yang yod pa ma yin no/

/zhes gsungs zhing / rig pa 'dzin pa zhes pa'i rig pa ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dus su me tog gang la phog pa'i lha dang / de'i sngags yin la de 'dzin pa ni bsgom bzlas kyi sgo nas yi dam gyi lha de nyid mnyes par byed pa'i thabs so/ /des na sngags sdom gyi ngo bo ni/ smin byed dbang gi dus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nas 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs grol byed lam gyi dus su gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa'i thabs khyad par can no/ /de ltar yang / phung po khams dang skyed mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsdu na/ rang sngags sdom du 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas thob cing 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i nges 'byung gi tshul khrims so/ /dbye na/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ bla med kyi sngags sdom dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gnas pa'i tshe ngo bo gcig dang tha dad gang du gnas dpyad pa dang / gtong ba'i tshe rim dang cig car gang du gtong dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs mi 'thad pa dgag pa dang / bod kyi lugs mi 'thad pa dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bhi bhu ta tsan+d+ra'i lugs mi 'thad pa dgag pa dang / a bh+ya ka ra'i lugs mi 'thad pa dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang / mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sdom gsum 'od phreng ba ltar na/ sdom pa gsum la thob gnas gtong gsum gyi khyad par/ ji ltar du ldan pa'i tshul/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ thob pa'i phan yon dang bzhi/ dang po la/ so thar/ byang sems/

sngags sdom gyi dbang du byas pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thob pa'i tshul ni/ rten gyi gang zag gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med gang rung bsam pa rang nyid 'khor ba las grol bar 'dod pas cho ga mkhan slob tshad ldan gyi drung du dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba'i tshul gyis thob par 'dod/ gnas pa'i tshul ni rten gyi gang zag dang sdom pa gnyis thob pa'i rdzas kyis sbrel ba'i tshul gyis gnas/ dper na/ glang la khal ldan par byed pa'i thag pa bzhin no/ /gtong tshul shi 'phos pa la sogs pas gtong bar bzhed de/ sdom gsum 'od phreng las/ gling gsum skyes pa bud med kyis/ /rang nyid 'khor ba grol don du/ /mkhan slob cho ga tshad ldan las/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar dag tu/ /gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa la/ /gtso cher lus ngag sdom pa ste/ /nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i sdom/ /gang zag glang po 'dra ba la/ /sdom pa khal dang 'dra ba ste/ /thob pa'i thag pas sbrel bar gnas/ /so so thar pa'i gnas tshul yin/ /bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang / /rtsa ba chad dang mtshan 'das dang / /mtshan gnyis cig car byung ba las/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa gtong / /gsungs so pham pa spyad pas kyang / /so thar sdom pa'i gtong tshul yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa byang sdom la/ thob pa'i tshul ni/ rten gyi gang zag lha mi gang rung gis bsam pa 'gro ba ma lus pa bskyab par 'dod pas cho ga slob dpon tshad ldan gyi drung du dus byang chub ma thob bar du rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa spong ba'i tshul gyis smon 'jug gi bdag nyid can gyi kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems thob par byed/ don dam byang chub kyi sems ni yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa'i stong nyid kyi don goms pa las thob par byed/ gnas pa'i tshul ni/ sems sems byung gis bsdus pa'i theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang / byang sdom nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin du gnas par byed/

gtong ba'i tshul ni/ rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa skyes pa dang nag po'i chos bzhis gtong ste/ tsha reg stobs chen po yod pa'i gzhir grang reg gi rgyun 'gog pa bzhin no/ /'bras bu byang chub thob pa'i tshe gtong ste/ chu sgrol zin pa'i gru gzings bzhin du dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ 'od phreng las/ lha mi la sogs gang rung gis/ /'gro ba ma lus bskyab pa'i phyir/ /slob dpon cho ga tshad ldan las/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can/ /lus ngag yid gsum rang don dang / /gzhan don thabs ma yin pas sdom/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi 'o/ /de nyid snang la rang bzhin med/ /'jig tshogs bzhin du goms pa las/ /yul dang yul can gnyis las grol/ /don dam byang chub sems yin no/ /sems dang sems byung sems bskyed gnyis/ /rang don gza' dang bral ba na/ /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin/ /de gnas pa yi tshul yin no/ /rang don blangs dang nag po yi/ /chos bzhis log par zhugs pa dang / /'bras bu dag ni thob pa na/ /tsha grang gru bzhin sems bskyed gtong / /zhes so/ /gsum pa sngags sdom la thob tshul ni/ rten gyi gang zag rigs bzhi gang rung gis bsam pa dgos 'dod phun tshogs 'byung bar 'dod pas cho ga bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du dus nam mkha' ma zhig gi bar du rnam rtog gi dri ma 'gog pa'i tshul gyis thob par byed do/ /gnas pa'i tshul ni rim gnyis kyi nyams len la brten nas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i tshul du gnas/ gtong ba'i tshul ni dgos med kyi blo skyes pa dang / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung bas gtong bar bzhed de/ rigs bzhi la sogs bsod nams ldan/ /rang gzhan dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs/ /bla ma mtshan nyid tshad ldan las/ /nam mkha' ji srid gnas par du/ /lhan skyes ye shes brda don 'phrod/ /rnam rtog dri ma kun las sdom/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i thob tshul yin/

/sku gsung thugs kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /rim gnyis yid bzhin nor bu spras/ /'dod yon lnga yis kun nas mchod/ /dgos 'dod kun gyi 'byung gnas pa/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnas tshul yin/ /dgos don med do skyon rnams byung / /dpag bsam shing bu 'gyel ba bzhin/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba na/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gtong / /zhes so/ gnyis pa ldan tshul la/ rgyud bzhi'i lung dgod pa dang / de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud sum brgya pa/ dam pa dang po/ rdo rje rtse mo/ rgyud 'bum pa bzhi las sdom gsum gyi rnam gzhag gsungs tshul ni/ 'od phreng las/ rgyud ni sum brgya pa las ni/ /'khor bzhi po la rjes su gnang / /rang nyid slob pa dang yang ldan/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya/ /gsungs so dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /rten ni gsum las dge slong mchog /'bring ni dge tshul yin par 'dod/ /khyim na gnas pa tha ma 'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ /gal te de ni rab byung gyur/ /sdom pa gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang / rgyud 'bum pa las/ 'di skad du/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag zhig /bzhu bas lcags dang zangs dngul 'byung / /gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /kun kyang gser du bsgyur ba bzhin/ /rigs can gsum gyi sdom pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs na/ /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kha cig rgyud de dag gi don sdom gsum gnas gyur ngo bo gcig tu 'dod zer ba mi 'thad de/ de la gnod byed kyi rigs pa yod pa'i phyir/ ji ltar yod na/ bud med la smod pa'i rtsa ltung gis bud med la reg pa spong ba'i sdom pa gtong bar thal/ sngags sdom dang so thar gyi sdom pa gnas gyur ngo bo gcig pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs pas sa'i lo tog skem par 'gyur ba dang sdom pa'i gtong rgyu sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa las gzhan byed rigs par thal lo/

/gzhan yang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gaṅgā'i chu bor gnas 'gyur ba yod par thal/ theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur ba yod pa gang zhig gnyis ka 'gal ba ltag sprod du chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sdom gsum gnas gyur pa'i tshe/ ngo bo gcig pa'i don gang la byed/ shes rgyud gcig la sdom gsum ngo bo tha dad dus mnyam du ldan pa la byed dam/ shes rgyud gcig la snga phyi rim gyis ldan pa la byed dam/ shes rgyud gcig la rdzas dbyer med gcig tu ldan pa la byed/ dang po ltar na/ ngo bo gcig pa'i don ma tshang ste/ sdom gsum rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na ngo bo gcig pa'i don mi gnas te/ snga phyi rim can du 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ltar na/ sdom pa gsum gyi gtong ba'i rgyu thob par byed pa'i cho ga la khyad par gtan med par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /zhes 'dod/ 'od phreng las/ gsungs pa'i don la kha cig ni/ sdom gsum gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig /gong ma'i rtsa ltung byung ba na/ /'og ma gtong zhes sgrogs pa yod/ /de la cung zhig brtag par bya/ /gsum ldan gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yis/ /gcig ldan gtong ba dgongs pa min/ /rigs pas kyang ni shin tu gnod/ /bud med la smod ltung ba yis/ /reg pa'i sdom pa gtong ngam ci/ /gal te gtong na ha cang thal/ /mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs pa yis/ /sa yi lo thog skem zhes sgre/ /gzhan yang sdom pa gtong thob rgyu/ /sangs rgyas gsung las gzhan pa yi/ /cho ga gzhan du byed rigs sam/ /gzhan yang 'gal ba ltag sprod la/ /gnas 'gyur brtsi ba rigs ma yin/ /rigs na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gaṅgā'i chu bor 'gyur zhes sgre/ /des na rang gis brtags nas blang / /sdom gsum ldan zhes gsungs pa de/ /shes rgyud gcig la brtsi na ni/ /gcig tu 'dod kyang gsum du 'gyur/ /ldan chos rdzas gzhan tha dad phyir/ /'on te snga phyi la brtsi na/

/gsum ldan zhes pa'i sgra don med/ /'on te sdom pa rdzas gcig tu/ /shes rgyud gcig la ldan zhe na/ /gtong thob cho ga gcig tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rang lugs la/ ldan tshul dang / rgyud kyi don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdom gsum ngo bo tha dad pa'i tshul du ldan te/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis byang sdom blangs pa'i tshe so thar gyi sdom pa kun gzhi la mi gsal ba bag la nyal gyi tshul du gnas/ byang sdom mngon 'gyur du ldan/ des sngags sdom blangs pa na dang po gnyis kun gzhi la mi gsal ba bag la nyal gyi tshul gyis gnas/ sngags sdom mngon 'gyur du ldan pa'i phyir/ dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na skar ma'i 'od nyams nas zla ba'i 'od mngon gyur du snang ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na zla skar gnyis ka'i 'od nyams nas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi 'jig rten gsal bar byed pa bzhin no/ /de yang sngags sdom dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis gdul bya gzhan don du sdom pa 'og ma gnyis po gang rung cho ga'i sgo nas blangs na gong ma zil gyis mi gnon cing sdom pa rang gi ngo bo skyes te/ sdom pa gsum gyi thob tshul dang gtong tshul rang rang gi gzhung lugs nas bshad pa ltar du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nyi ma gnas pa'i tshe zla skar 'char ba bkag pa med pa bzhin no/ /zhes bzhed/ de nas so thar sdom pa yis/ /byang chub mchog gi sems blangs na/ /dang po de ni kun gzhi la/ /bag la nyal ba'i tshul du gnas/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa thob pa na/ /'og ma gnyis ka bag la nyal/ /dper na mkha' la rgyu skar shar/ /cung zad snang bar byas gyur mod/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na/ /rgyu skar 'od nyams 'jig rten snang / /rta bdun tsha zer shar ba na/ /zla ba'i 'od nyams 'jig rten gsal/ /gal te rig pa 'dzin pa yis/ /gdul bya gang dang gang don du/ /'og ma'i sdom pa blangs pa na/

/gong ma zil gyis mi gnon mod/ /sdom pa cho gas thob pa yin/ /mkha' la nyi ma gnas gyur mod/ /zla skar 'char ba bkag pa med/ /des na gtong thob gnas pa'i tshul/ /rang rang cho ga bzhin du gnas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi rgyud de dag gi don/ sdom pa 'og ma dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis gong ma blangs pa'i tshe 'og ma gong mar gnas 'gyur ba ma yin te/ 'og ma dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis gong ma blangs pa'i tshe gong ma'i yon tan mchog dang ldan pas 'og ma zil gyis gnon pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis zla skar gyi 'od zil gyis gnon pa bzhin no/ /zhes bzhed/ gser 'gyur rtsi zhes gsungs pa'i don/ /zil gnon yon tan mchog la dgongs/ /zla skar gnyis kyi 'od zer yang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas kyi bar/ /nyi ma'i 'od ces kun gyis sgrogs/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa nyams pa'i nyes dmigs la/ so thar las nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ so thar sdom pa nyams gyur na/ /rang gis rang bslus gnod pa mang / /rgyal dang de sras thams cad kyis/ /cung zad khrel gyi shin tu min/ /pham pa'i lci yang bye brag gis/ /lo grangs ngan song gsum du gnas/ /zhes so/ /byang sems las nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ byang sems nyams na 'gro ba kun/ /bslus te gnod pa shin tu mang / /rgyal dang de sras thams cad dang / /'gro ba kun gyis shin tu khrel/ /pham pa'i lci yang bye brag gis/ /bskal pa'i grangs bzhin dmyal bar gnas/ /zhes so/ /sngags sdom las nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ rig 'dzin sdom pa nyams gyur na/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /rgyal dang de sras kun brnyas pas/ /mi 'jigs mnar med gnas dag tu/ /sdug bsngal chen po de yis myong / /bskal pa ther 'bum la sogs su/ /de ni thon par ma gsungs so/ /bzhi pa phan yon la/ 'od phreng las/ so thar sdom pa'i phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs lha mi mthar thug gi

/dgra bcom 'bras bu nges par 'thob/ /byang sems sdom pa'i phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs bde mang mthar thug ni/ ring mo zhig nas rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i phan yon ni/ /gnas skabs nyid nas kun mkhyen gyi/ /bde ba che la longs spyod 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ gtong ba'i rgyu mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag gnas gyur ngo bo gcig pa la brjod pa'i skyon mi 'thad pa/ rang lugs kyi ldan tshul mi 'thad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ pham pa byung ba nyan thos lugs kyi so thar sdom pa'i gtong rgyur bshad pa mi 'thad de/ de'i lugs la pham pa byung ba'i dge slong gi rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa'i rdzas tshang bar yod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod du/ kha che rnams ni byung ba la/ /bu lon nor bzhin gnyis su 'dod/ /ces so/ /rgya cher 'grel las/ dge slong pham par gyur pa la ni sdom pa yod du zin kyang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i tshe byang sems kyi sdom pa gtong bar bshad pa yang mi 'thad de/ 'o na de'i tshe theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed btang bar thal/ khas blangs pa de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ theg chen sems bskyed dang byang sdom nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin gnas par khas blangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed gzhi ma grub par thal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thal 'gyur dang po la/ bud med la smod pa'i rtsa ltung byung bas bud med la reg pa spong ba'i sdom pa zil gyis gnon par thal/ sdom gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i tshe sngags sdom gyis so thar gyi sdom pa zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs pas sa'i lo tog 'phel ba zil gyis gnon par thal lo/ /thal 'gyur gnyis pa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gaṅgā'i chu bor gnas 'gyur ba yod par thal/ theg dman sems bskyed theg chen sems bskyed du gnas 'gyur ba yod pa gang zhig

de gnyis 'gal ba ltag sprod du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur gsum pa'i lan ni/ bdag med gsum la rtogs dka' sla'i khyad par cung zad kyang med par thal/ theg pa gsum rim gyis bgrod pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi bdag med gsum rtogs pa'i rtogs pa gsum rdzas gcig pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams khas/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i sdom pa mngon 'gyur du ldan pa'i gang zag yin na gzhan la gnod pa spong ba'i sdom pa mngon 'gyur du rgyud la mi ldan pas khyab par thal ba dang / 'bras bu lam byed kyi thabs kyis zin pa'i sdom pa mngon 'gyur du rgyud la ldan na gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i sdom pa dang gzhan la gnod pa spong ba'i sdom pa mngon 'gyur du rgyud la mi ldan pas khyab pa'i skyon yod cing / gzhan yang / rdo rje theg pa dang mthun pa'i nyams len yin na phar phyin theg pa dang mthun pa'i nyams len dang 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i nyams len ma yin dgos par thal/ sngags sdom yin na sdom pa 'og ma gnyis po ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sdom dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis so thar gyi sdom pa cho ga'i sgo nas blangs pas byang sdom zil gyis mi gnon cing so thar gyi sdom pa skye ba mi 'thad par thal/ so thar sdom pa'i yan lag tu rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa dgos pa dang rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa skyes pa na byang sdom gtong ba khas blangs pa'i phyir/ rgyud kyi lung don 'chad pa yang mi 'thad de/ 'o na gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags dang zangs gser gyi ngo bor bsgyur mi nus par lcags zangs zil gyis gnon pa tsam du thal/ sdom pa gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i tshe sdom pa 'og ma sngags sdom du 'gyur mi srid par/ sdom pa 'og ma zil gyis gnon pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de gnyis dpe don du sbyar nas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ a bh+ya ka ra'i lugs la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang /

de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdom gsum rim bzhin blangs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum po de gzugs can ngo bo tha dad pa'i tshul gyis cig car du ldan te/ sdom pa gong ma thob pa'i tshe 'og ma gtong ba yang ma yin/ 'og ma gong mar gnas 'gyur ba yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dang po grub ste/ gong ma 'og ma'i gtong rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ gsum po de rdul phran bsags pa'i gzugs can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ngo bo tha dad pa'i tshul du ldan pa la 'gal ba med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ skyes bu gcig la rgyan sna tshogs kyis rim gyis spras pa'i tshe rgyan de rnams gzugs can ngo bo tha dad cig car du ldan pa bzhin no/ /zhes 'dod de/ thub pa dgongs rgyan las/ 'o na gang zag la la ji ltar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang dge tshul dang dge slong dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa rim pa bzhin du khas blangs pa na me dang bral ba na grang ba ltar sdom pa phyi ma skye dus snga ma 'jig gam/ yang na so thar gyi spong ba 'phel ba dang ldan pa ltar snga phyi lhan cig gam/ yang na nyi ma gcig la sna tshogs pa'i rgyan bzhin du so sor gnas pa brjod ce na/ sdom pa nyams pa'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir bsags pa kho na la 'di rnams kyi tha snyad rnam par 'jog pas snga ma gnyis ma yin gyi sdom pa gong ma thams cad blangs na skyes te so sor gnas pa kho na'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de mi 'thad de/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces dang / mdo las/ gang gzugs dge ba dang mi dge bar smra ba de ni shākya'i bu ma yin shākya'i sras ma yin shākya'i dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes dge ba gzugs can pa bkag nas tshul khrims kyi phar phyin shes par bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang byang sems kyi nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims de byang sems kyi sdom pa ma yin par thal/

byang sems kyi rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun byang sems kyi sdom pa'i ngo bor skye ba gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyi mtshan gzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sems kyi sdom pa dang theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa gang zag gcig gi rgyud la lhan cig tu ldan pa yod par thal/ byang sems kyi sdom pa las rdzas gzhan pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa dang byang sdom gnyis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dus mnyam du ldan pa yod pa gang zhig theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom las rdzas gzhan du med pa'i phyir te/ theg chen so thar rigs bdun ni byang sdom gyi mtshan gzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ nye bar 'khor de la nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims yongs su ma dag pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa gang yin pa de ni nyan thos kyi tshul khrims yongs su ma dag pa nyid yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ni skad cig tsam srid par skye ba len par spro na'ang nyams pa yin la byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don la bskal pa dpag tu med par 'khor bar gnas pa la mi skyo ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sdom gsum las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i lugs dgag pa dang / sdom gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs kyang don ma rtogs pa'i lugs dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bod kyi sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdzad pa kha cig na re/ dang por so thar rigs bdun de nas byang sdom dang sngags sdom rim gyis thob pa'i tshe snga phyi rten dang brten pa rdzas gzhan pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa yin la sdom pa gong ma gong ma'i rten du 'og ma 'og ma nges par sngon du 'gro dgos te/

dper na/ gzhong pa'i nang du chu blugs nas de'i nang du nor bu bzhag pa bzhin no zhes zer/ gnyis pa la/ rten dang brten pa yin pa dgag pa/ rdzas gzhan yin pa dgag pa/ dpe don mi mtshungs pa'i sgo nas dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang sdom gyi rten du nges par dgos pa'i so thar sdom pa de nyan thos so thar la byed dam theg chen so thar la byed/ dang po ltar na mi 'thad de/ nyan thos so thar sngon du ma song bar byang sdom skye ba yang yod cing nyan thos so thar dang byang sdom gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dus mnyam cig car du ldan pa yang mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na mi 'thad de/ theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa ni byang sdom las rdzas gzhan du med la byang sdom gyi rten du gyur pa'i so thar ni byang sdom las rdzas gzhan du khas blangs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / theg chen du rigs nges pa'i gang zag gis so thar gyi sdom pa sngon du ma song bar byang sems kyi sems bskyed thob pa gzhi ma grub par thal/ des so thar gyi sdom pa sngon du ma song bar byang sems kyi sdom pa thob pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sngags lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag yin na/ skal dman rim 'jug pa yin dgos par thal/ so thar dang byang sems sngon du ma song bar sngags kyi sdom pa dngos su skye kha ma'i skal ldan cig car ba gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sdom dang sngags sdom nges par rdzas gzhan yin na/ de gnyis bem por gyur ba'i rdzas gzhan nam shes par gyur pa'i rdzas gzhan gang yin/ dang po mi 'thad de/ gzugs can yin pa gong du bkag zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du spong sems rdzas gzhan pa gnyis cig car du 'byung ba yod par thal/ sngags sdom gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i spong sems dang byang sdom gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i spong sems gnyis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dus mnyam du ldan pa yod cing de gnyis rdzas gzhan du khas blangs pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang / gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i sdom pa yin na gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i sdom pa las rdzas gzhan yin dgos par thal/ so thar gyi sdom pa yin na byang sdom las rdzas gzhan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du sngags sdom la yang sbyor/ gsum pa ni/ gzhong pa de chu med pa'i nor bu dang chu dang bcas pa'i nor bu gnyis ka'i rten du rung ba ltar/ so thar gyi sdom pa de byang sdom med pa'i sngags sdom dang byang sdom dang bcas pa'i sngags sdom gnyis ka'i rten du rung bar thal/ sdom pa gsum po de gzhong pa'i nang du chu blug nas de'i nang du nor bu bzhag pa bzhin du rten du brten pa'i rdzas gzhan kho na yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ sngags sdom la nges par sdom pa 'og ma gnyis sngon du 'gro dgos par khas blangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sdom gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs kyang don ma rtogs pa'i lugs dgag pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kun mkhyen dga' ba gdong pa'i ṭika chen las/ da ni 'di dpyad par bya ste/ kha cig sdom pa gsum po rje btsun chen pos rtsa ltung 'khrul spong du ngo bo gcig tu gsungs pa paṇ+ḍi ta bhi bhu ta tsan+d+ras sdom gsum 'od kyi phreng bar nyi zla skar gsum gyi dpes ngo bo gcig pa bkag nas rdzas gzhan du bshad ces zer ro/ /de ni ri bong gi cal ltar yin te/ rje btsun chen pos dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu'i sdom gsum gnas gyur pa'i tshe sgra zin la ngo bo gcig ces gsungs pa de yang de'i tshe sdom gsum rgyun rdzas gcig la dgongs pa yin gyi sdom pa'i skad cig snga phyi rdzas gcig par ni mi bzhed de/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad ldan dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / dge slong pha ma lta bu mtshan gyur pa'i tshe sdom pa de gnyis rdzas kyi rgyun gcig pa yin gyi pha ma'i sdom pa ni rdzas gcig ces mi bya ste/

mdzod las/ tha dad de dag 'gal ba med/ /ces dang / rang 'grel du/ sdom pa de dag lnga dang bcu dang nyi shu zhes bya ba lta bu dang / dong tse gcig dang gnyis zhes bya ba bzhin du gzhan dang gzhan zhes bya ba'am/ 'on te de dag thams cad tha dad pa nyid gcig tu skye zhe na/ smras pa tha dad pa de dag ni ma 'dres pa nyid de sdom pa gsum dag la srog gcod pa spong ba gsum nas myos par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba spong ba gsum gyi bar mtshan nyid tha dad par skye ste/ lhag ma rnams kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /de dag la khyad par ci yod ce na/ gzhi'i khyad par las khyad par yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sdom gsum rdzas tha dad kyang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la sdom gsum ldan pa'i tshul ni rkyen dbang gis gcig mngon du gyur pa na gcig shos gnyis dbang ldan gyi tshul gyis ldan te/ thob byed kyi rgyus thob la gtong byed kyi rgyus nyams par ma byas pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa la/ gnas gyur ngo bo gcig pa'i don bshad tshul mi 'thad pa/ mdzod kyi gzhung don bshad tshul mi 'thad pa/ sdom gsum gyi ldan tshul mi 'thad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'khrul spong las sdom gsum ngo bo gcig tu gsungs pa 'od phreng mkhan pos bkag pa ma yin no zhes smra ba ni phyogs snga dang de'i lan khong du ma chud par zad de/ 'khrul spong du rgyud 'bum pa'i lung drangs nas gnas gyur ngo bo gcig tu dngos su bshad/ 'od phreng du rgyud 'bum pa'i lung don gnas gyur ngo bo gcig tu 'dod pa la gnod byed gsum dngos su bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sdom gsum gnas gyur du 'dod pa khas blangs nang 'gal te/ so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom du gnas 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i phyir te/ so thar gyi sdom pa ni gzugs can dang / byang sdom shes pa gang zhig bem pos shes pa'i nyer len byed pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po khas blangs/

sdom pa'i skad cig snga phyi rdzas gcig pa mi 'thad de/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhes skyon brjod pa yang don med kho na yin te/ sdom pa'i skad cig snga phyi rdzas gcig tu sus kyang khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ tha dad de dag 'gal ba med ces pa rtsa 'grel gyi don dge slong pha ma'i sdom pa rdzas gzhan yin pa la sbyor ba mi 'thad de/ lung de dag ni tshigs gsum rim gyis khas blangs pa'i dge slong gi rgyud kyi dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa gsum rdzas tha dad yin yang dus mnyam cig car du ldan pa la 'gal ba med par ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'od phreng mkhan po'i ldan tshul dang 'di'i ldan tshul don gcig pas 'od phreng mkhan po la brjod pa'i skyon rnams 'dir dran par bya'o/ /gzhan yang / dge slong gi sdom pa'i nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung yin na/ sngags sdom nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung ma yin dgos par thal/ dge slong gi sdom pa yin na sngags sdom ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas spyad pa'i bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i srog gcod kyi pham pas ma nges so/ /gzhan yang / byang sdom las nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung yin na/ sngags sdom las nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung ma yin dgos par thal/ byang sdom yin na sngags sdom ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems rdo rje 'dzin pas spyad pa'i smon pa byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba'i rtsa ltung chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems btang ba'i rtsa ltung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de de yin par thal/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i rtsa ltung yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ bshad bya'i lung drang ba dang / lung gi don bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma spangs pa rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/

sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel par/ de ltar na rdo rje rtse mo las/ sdom pa gsum la gnas pa ni/ /dang po'i khrus su bshad pa yin/ /zhes gang zag gcig gi rgyud la so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gsum dang ldan par gsungs pa 'gal lo zhe na/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ spyir so sor thar pa'i rang gi ngo bo ni/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las log pa yin la de'i steng du gzhan la phan par 'dod cing zhugs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yin zhing / de'i steng du rig pa 'dzin pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin no/ /de la so sor thar pa ni gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi so sor thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'o/ /'dir byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa ni sdom pa thob pa dang gnas pa gnyis ka'i rten du rung gi snga ma ni de ltar ma yin pas/ rdo rje rtse mo'i dgongs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa de blang ba'i cho ga gzhan zhig yod dam/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nyid yin zhe na/ sngar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa thob na/ phyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dus sngar gyi de byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par gnas 'gyur la/ sngar ma thob na ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon pa'i dus nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yin no/ /zhes pa dang / 'khrul spong las/ 'dir kha cig 'di skad du/ gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /zhes bya ba thun mong gi skyabs 'gro dang / so sor thar pa la 'chad cing / rdo rje rtse mo las/ so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi ngo bo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa gnyis ka'ang skyon dang bcas pa yin te/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gnyis nang mi 'gal mod/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i rten du mi rung ste/

so sor thar pa ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med ma yin pa gzhan la mi skye la/ byang chub kyi sems ni 'gro ba mtha' dag la skye bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang gnas pa'i rten du yang mi 'thad de/ so sor thar pa ni shi nas gtong la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du mi gtong ba'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so sor thar pa 'di ni thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du mi rung bar khyed smra ba bzhin du kho bo cag kyang smra'o/ /'o na khyed kyi so sor thar pa sngon du ma song ba'i sdom pa gsum gang yin zhe na/ 'dir so sor thar pa'i rang bzhin ni gzhan la gnod par byed pa gzhi dang bcas pa las log pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni de'i steng du gzhan la phan 'dogs par zhugs pa yin zhing / rig pa 'dzin pa ni de dag kyang lha'i rnam par ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod pas na/ 'di la 'gal ba ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /'o na sngar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dge slong gi bar thob pa zhig gis phyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas slar yang dbang mnos par gyur na/ 'di la sdom pa gsum ji ltar ldan zhe na/ dge slong gis sems bskyed pa'i tshe so sor thar pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i tshe na/ sdom pa thams cad kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de skad du/ rgyud 'bum pa'i lung de kho na nyid kyi ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba las byung ba/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag zhig /bzhu bas lcags dang zangs dngul 'byung / /gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /kun kyang gser du bsgyur bar byed/ /de bzhin sems kyi bye brag gis/ /rigs can gsum gyi sdom pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpe de'i rdo ni phal pa yin la/

lcags ni nyan thos kyi bslab par bya ba/ zangs ni rang rgyal gyi bslab par bya ba/ dngul ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par bya ba yin zhing / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ni rdo rje theg pa'i bslab par bya ba yin par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ rten dang brten par 'gyur tshul/ sdom gsum ngo bo gcig tshul spyir bshad pa/ gnas gyur nas ngo bo gcig tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ so thar rigs bdun gang rung zhig byang sdom thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du nges par dgos te/ rigs bdun gang rung sngon du ma song bar byang sems kyi sdom pa skye ba yang med/ rigs bdun gang rung dang mi ldan pa la byang sdom dang ldan pa khas mi len pa'i phyir te/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi/ /zhes sogs dang / des na sems tsam pa yi lugs/ /gal te sems bskyed de 'dod na/ /thog mar so sor thar pa longs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ cho ga nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so thar rigs bdun byang sems kyi sdom pa thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du nges par dgos pa ma yin te/ de dag sngon du ma song bar yang byang sdom skye ba dang de dag dang mi ldan pa'i rgyud la yang byang sdom dang ldan pa khas len pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di/ /sems can kun gyis legs thob na/ /zhes sogs dang / ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang byang sdom thob zin gnas pa'i rten du theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa nges par dgos te/ theg chen so thar dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la byang sdom dang ldan pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang / sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭi kar/ de la so sor thar pa ni gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi so sor thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yin no/

/zhes pa'i bar dang / 'khrul spong du/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i rten du mi rung ste/ zhes pa nas/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i so sor thar pa 'di ni thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du mi rung bar khyed smra ba bzhin du kho bo cag kyang smra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang 'dir so sor thar pa rigs bdun byang sdom gyi thob pa dang gnas pa'i rten du mi dgos pa'i dam bca' de nyid khas len pa yin gyi so thar shi 'phos nas gtong bar bshad pa'i sgrub byed khas len pa ma yin te/ so thar shi 'phos pa tsam gyis mi gtong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa/ byang sdom/ sngags sdom dang gsum khyab bya dang khyab byed kyi tshul gyis ngo bo gcig pa yin te/ so thar ni gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa spong bas rab tu phye ba'i sdom pa yin/ byang sdom ni de'i steng du gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ sngags sdom ni de dag gnyis ka'i steng du 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ go sla ba'i dpe ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gsum khyab bya khyab byed kyi tshul gyi ngo bo gcig pa bzhin no/ /de yang sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭi kar/ so sor thar pa'i rang gi ngo bo ni/ zhes pa nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin no zhes pa'i bar dang / 'khrul spong du/ 'o na khyed kyi so sor thar pa sngon du ma song ba'i sdom pa gang yin/ zhes pa nas/ 'di la 'gal ba ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ sdom pa gang zhig gang du gnas 'gyur pa/ gnas gyur pa'i tshe ngo bo gcig pa'i don/ zhar byung gi don gzhan bshad pa dang gsum/

dang po la/ gang gnas 'gyur ba/ gang du gnas 'gyur ba/ gang gi stobs kyis gnas 'gyur ba/ ji ltar du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul/ de ltar gnas gyur pa'i dpe dang lnga/ dang po ni/ theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa dang / 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs kyis ma zin pa'i byang sdom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang po de byang sdom dang / de gnyis ka sngags sdom du'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis theg dman so thar byang sdom du gnas 'gyur/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis 'og ma gnyis sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi pa la/ byang sdom du gnas 'gyur tshul dang / sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom du gnas 'gyur mi dgos te/ theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom gyi ngo bor grub zin pa'i phyir/ theg dman so thar gyi sdom pa byang sdom du gnas 'gyur ba yin te/ theg dman so thar de la gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i sdom pa'i ldog cha dang / rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i dman sems kyi ldog cha gnyis yod cing / theg dman so thar rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i tshe/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pa khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i sdom pa'i rdzas gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i tshul gyis byang sdom du gnas 'gyur/ dman sems kyi ldog cha rtsa ba nas btang ba'i tshul gyis phan sems khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg dman so thar gnas 'gyur tshul dang / byang sdom gnas 'gyur tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman so thar sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul yod de/ theg dman so thar la gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i ldog cha dang /

'bras bu lam byed kyi thabs kyis ma zin pa'i tha mal snang zhen gyi ldog cha gnyis yod cing / theg dman so thar dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang thob pa'i tshe/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis snga ma de nyid rdzas gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i tshul gyis sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur/ phyi ma de nyid rtsa ba nas btang ba'i tshul gyis 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sdom sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul yod de/ byang sdom la gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i sdom pa'i ldog cha dang / 'bras bu lam byed kyi thabs kyis ma zin pa'i tha mal snang zhen gyi ldog cha gnyis yod cing / byang sdom rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gis dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang nos pa'i tshe/ 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis snga ma de rdzas gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i tshul gyis sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur/ phyi ma de rtsa ba nas btang ba'i tshul gyis 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi so thar/ theg chen gyi rgyud kyi byang sdom/ 'bras bu lam byed kyi thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis sngags sdom du gnas 'gyur ba'i dpe yod de/ lcags zangs dngul gsum gser 'gyur gyi rtsis zin pa la brten nas gser du 'gyur ba dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de yang / 'o na sngar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dge slong gi bar thob pa zhig gis/ zhes pa nas/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ni rdo rje theg pa'i bslab par bya ba yin par mngon no zhes pa'i bar gyi don legs par bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa dang / rang gi lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha cig sdom gsum gnas gyur ngo bo gcig pa'i don/

dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi so thar byang sems sngags sdom gsum yin khyab mnyam pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo gcig pa yin gyi/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi dge slong gi sdom pa dang de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa gong ma gnyis yin khyab mnyam ma yin te/ de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa gong ma gnyis po yin na/ dge slong gi sdom pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ dge slong gi sdom pa shi 'phos pa'i dbang gis gtong la byang sdom dang sngags sdom shi 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir zhes zer/ 'o na dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la dge tshul sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i byang sdom dang dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i byang sdom ngo bo tha dad pa gnyis cig car du ldan par thal/ de'i rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa yin pa'i byang sdom dang / de ma yin pa'i byang sdom gnyis cig car du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i spong sems dang / dge tshul sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i spong sems ngo bo tha dad pa gnyis cig car du ldan pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa de gang zhig dge slong dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa gzugs can pa gnyis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ldan pa med pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag yin na/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa rgyud ldan yin dgos par thal/ dge slong gi sdom pa dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa ngo bo tha dad cig car du rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshogs lam thob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag yin na/ tshogs lam rgyud ldan yin dgos par thal lo/ /gzhan yang / dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i spong sems dang / dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bor ma gyur pa'i spong sems gyi sdom pa ngo bo tha dad pa gnyis cig car du ldan par thal/

de'i rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa yin pa'i byang sdom dang / dge slong gi sdom pa ma yin pa'i byang sdom gnyis cig car du ldan pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gzhan yang / dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi byang sdom yin na/ dge slong gi bslab bya la slob dgos kyi sdom pa yin pas ma khyab par thal ba dang / dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yin na/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pas ma khyab par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa yin na/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi dge slong gi sdom pa dang / sngags sdom la sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rang lugs la gcig ldan gyi dbang du byas pa/ gnyis ldan gyi dbang du byas pa/ gsum ldan gyi dbang du byas pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni theg dman so thar rgyud ldan gyi gang zag ste/ 'di la so thar tsam ldan gyi gong ma gnyis mi ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngags sdom ma thob pa'i byang sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa ste/ 'di'i rgyud la theg chen so thar gyi sdom pa dang byang sdom gnyis rdzas dbyer med kyi tshul du ldan pa'i phyir/ bye brag tu dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la rang rgyud kyi so thar/ byang sdom dge slong gi sdom gsum ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis ldan te/ de'i rgyud kyi nges 'byung gi tshul khrims de gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba'i cha nas so thar/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i bsam pas zin pa'i cha nas byang sdom/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bslab bya la slob pa'i cha nas dge slong gi sdom par bzhag pa'i phyir/ dper na/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes/ lam shes/ sgom lam gsum ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas tha dad du phye ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngags sdom dang ldan pa'i gang zag ste/

sngags sdom yin na so thar dang byang sdom yin pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi so thar byang sdom sngags sdom dge slong gi sdom pa bzhi po de ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas tha dad du phye ba yin te/ de'i rgyud kyis nges 'byung gi tshul khrims de gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas spong ba la sogs pa'i cha nas sdom pa bzhi char du bzhag pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen bzhi po de ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas tha dad du phye ba bzhin no/ /de ltar yang / sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang / /de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang / rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas kyang / sdom gsum cho gar mi 'gyur bas/ /sngags kyi bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa zhar byung la/ tshigs gsum gyi ldan tshul la dpyad pa dang / gong mas 'og ma thob tshul la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gsum rim gyis blangs pa'i tshe de gsum ngo bo tha dad du ldan nam/ ngo bo gcig tu ldan nam/ snga ma phyi mar gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul du ldan zhe na/ 'di la gzugs can du 'dod pa'i lugs dang / shes par 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ tshigs gsum rim gyis nos pa'i dge slong gi rgyud la/ gsum po de ngo bo tha dad dus mnyam du ldan te/ de'i rgyud la gsum po de thob byed kyi rgyus thob/ gtong byed kyi rgyus ma btang ba'i gzugs can ngo bo tha dad yin pa'i phyir te/ tha dad de dag 'gal ba med/ /ces dang / rang 'grel las/ sdom pa de dag lnga dang bcu dang nyi shu/ zhes bya ba lta bu dang / dong tse gcig dang gnyis zhes bya ba bzhin du gzhan dang gzhan zhes bya ba'am/

'on te de dag thams cad tha dad pa nyid gcig tu skye zhe na/ smras pa tha dad pa de dag ni ma 'dres pa nyid de/ sdom pa gsum dag la srog gcod pa spong ba gsum nas myos par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba spong ba gsum gyi bar du mtshan nyid tha dad par skyes te/ lhag ma rnams kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pa ltar na/ tshigs gsum rim gyis nod pa'i dge slong gi rgyud la de gsum ngo bo tha dad cig car du ldan pa ma yin te/ de yin na gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du spong sems rdzas gzhan pa gsum cig car du ldan par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum ngo bo gcig tu ldan pa yang ma yin te/ shes rgyud gcig la de gsum gyi gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na tshigs gsum rim gyis nod pa'i dge slong gi rgyud la snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi mar rdzas gong 'phel du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis ldan te/ dge bsnyen gyis dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs pa'i tshe dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i ngo bor 'gyur/ dge tshul gyis dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pa'i tshe dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bor 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na/ tshogs lam nas sbyor lam sbyor lam nas mthong lam du gnas 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na dge slong gi rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yin gyi dge tshul gyi sdom pa yod par khas len pa mi rigs te/ dge slong gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum po de gzugs can ngo bo tha dad dang shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdzas tha dad gang du yang med pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis cig car du ldan pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas gsol bzhi'i cho ga'i sgo nas dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pa'i tshe dge slong gi sdom pa sngags sdom las ngo bo tha dad du skye ba yin nam/

ngo bo gcig tu skye ba gang yin/ dang po ltar na sdom gsum ngo bo gcig tu khas blangs pa dang nang 'gal/ gnyis pa ltar na/ sdom pa gong ma yang 'og mar gnas 'gyur ba yod par 'gyur zhe na/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pa'i tshe sdom pa de gnyis ngo bo tha dad du skye ba ma yin te/ de'i tshe khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sngags sdom de nyid dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor skye ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang sngags sdom dge slong gi sdom par gnas gyur pa'i tha snyad mi 'dogs te/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa skyes pa'i tshe sngar gyi sngags sdom rang gi ngo bo ma btang bar yod pa dang / sngags sdom de nyid dge slong gi sdom pa la ltos te dman pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsod spang la/ rtsod pa dang / lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsol bzhi'i cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i sngags sdom yod par thal/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sngags sdom yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngags sdom thob phyir du dbang gi cho ga gsungs pa don med du thal lo/ /gzhan yang / dbang bskur gyi cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par thal/ sngags sdom gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge slong gi sdom pa thob phyir du gsol bzhi'i cho ga gsungs pa don med par thal lo zer/ gnyis pa la/ 'o na byang sdom 'bogs pa'i cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par thal/ byang sdom gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom yod pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims su gyur pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par byang sa las bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge slong gi sdom pa thob phyir du gsol bzhi'i cho ga gsungs pa don med par thal lo/ /gzhan yang gsol bzhi'i cho ga la brten nas thob pa'i byang sdom yod par thal/

dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i byang sdom yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sdom thob phyir du de'i cho ga gsungs pa don med par thal lo/ /gzhan yang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud la 'bras bu lam byed kyi thabs kyis ma zin pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la sngags sdom las don gzhan pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ dge slong byang sems kyi rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa yod par thal lo/ /gnyis pa gtong tshul la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo tha dad pa'i phyogs la mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa dang / ngo bo gcig pa'i phyogs la mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kha cig shi 'phos pa dang mtshan gnyis cig car du byung ba so thar sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin te/ de ltar 'dul ba las bshad pa'i phyir/ byang sems kyi rtsa ltung byang sems sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin te/ sngags kyi rtsa ltung sngags sdom gyi gtong rgyur bshad pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /mi 'thad de/ dge slong gi sdom pa de ji srid 'tsho'i bar gyi gzugs can gyi sdom par thal/ de ltar du 'dul ba las bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sems kyi rtsa ltung byung ba tsam gyis byang sdom gtong ba mi 'thad de/ byang sems kyi rtsa ltung kun dkris chen pos spyad na gtong ba yin kyang kun dkris 'bring dang chung ngus spyad na bshags pa tsam gyis dag par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po kha cig na re/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gtong tshul la/ dge slong gi sdom pa btang nas gong ma gnyis mi gtong ba'i mu/ gong ma gnyis btang nas dge slong gi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i mu/

dge slong gi sdom pa dang sngags sdom btang nas byang sdom mi gtong ba'i mu/ sngags sdom btang nas 'og ma gnyis mi gtong ba'i mu/ gsum char dus mnyam du gtong ba dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas sems can gyi don du 'gyur ba'i dgos ched khyad par can gyi tshe dge slong gi bslab pa phul ba lta bu ste/ de'i tshe dge slong sdom pa'i gtong rgyu byung la gong ma gnyis kyi gtong rgyu ma byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ des smon pa byang chub kyi sems btang ba ste gong ma gnyis kyi gtong rgyu byung la dge slong gi sdom pa'i gtong rgyu ma byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dge slong gis pham pa bzhi spyad pa lta bu ste/ dge slong gi sdom pa nyams byed kyi pham pa dang bder gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsa ltung du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ des gsang sgrogs kyi rtsa ltung spyad pa lta bu ste/ ltung ba de nyid sngags sdom gyi gtong rgyu yin la 'og ma gnyis kyi gtong rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ smon sems btang nas srog gcod kyi pham pa spyad pa lta bu ste/ sdom pa gsum ka'i rtsa ltung byung ba'i phyir/ de yang byang sdom btang nas sngags sdom mi gtong ba'i mu yod pa ma yin te/ sngags sdom byang sdom gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ so thar btang nas gong ma gnyis mi gtong ba'i mu yod pa ma yin te gong ma gnyis so thar sdom pa'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung ngo / /'di dag la yang mi 'thad pa'i cha yod de/ gtong ba'i tshul mi 'thad pa dang sgrub byed la mgo mtshungs pa'i skyon gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud la byang sdom ma yin pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la smon pa byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba'i rtsa ltung byung ba'i tshe rang rgyud kyi byang sdom mtha' dag gtong ba gang zhig rang rgyud kyi so thar gyi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i phyir te/

rang rgyud kyi dge slong gi sdom pa mi gtong bar khas blangs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud la sngags sdom ma yin pa'i byang sdom yod par thal/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas gsang sgrogs kyi rtsa ltung spyad pa'i tshe rang rgyud kyi sngags sdom mtha' dag gtong ba gang zhig rang rgyud kyi byang sdom mi gtong bar khas blangs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi byang sdom chos can/ de'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom dang grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i sdom pa ma yin par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom nyams byed kyi ltung ba yin na/ khyod nyams byed kyi ltung ba yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pas spyad pa'i gsang sgrogs kyi rtsa ltung chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ gzhan yang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom chos can/ de'i rgyud kyi so thar gyi sdom pa dang ngo bo dbyer med grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i sdom pa ma yin par thal/ khyod nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung yin na/ de'i rgyud kyi so thar gyi sdom pa nyams byed kyi rtsa ltung yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom btang nas dge slong gi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i mu yod pa mi 'thad par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi dge slong gi sdom pa de de'i rgyud kyi sngags sdom gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du de'i rgyud kyi byang sdom dang dge slong gi sdom pa la sbyar te stobs mtshungs kyi 'khor gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa rang lugs la/ so so'i gtong rgyu dang / thun mong gi gtong rgyu gnyis/ dang po la/ so thar/ byang sdom/ sngags sdom gyi gtong rgyu dang gsum/ dang po la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang / rang phyogs ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las/

bslab pa phul ba/ shi 'phos pa/ mtshan gnyis cig car du byung ba/ mtshan lan gsum du 'gyur ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa rnams so thar spyi'i gtong rgyu dang mtshan mo mtha'i skad cig ma 'das pa bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin te/ mdzod las/ bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang / /mtshan gnyis dag ni byung ba dang / /rtsa ba chad dang mtshan 'das las/ /so sor thar pa'i 'dul ba gtong / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i pham pa bzhi sdom pa'i gtong rgyu ma yin te/ pham pa byung ba'i dge slong gi rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi lugs la/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa shi 'phos pa tsam gyis gtong ba ma yin te/ so thar gyi sdom pa de rang gi nyer len sems las byung ba'i sdom pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ shes pa'i ngo bor gyur ba'i sdom pa ni gtong rgyu gzhan ma byung na ji srid sems ma nyams pa de srid du gnas par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rab dbye las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ /sems las skyes phyir gzugs can min/ /des na ji srid sems ma nyams/ /de yi bar du sdom pa yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan gnyis cig car du byung ba dang / mtshan lan gsum du gyur pa yang 'dir so thar gyi sdom pa'i gtong rgyur mi 'dod de/ de dag ni ltung ba dang sdom pa gnyis ka gtso bor gzugs can du 'dod pa bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs yin la/ 'dir ni spang bya ltung ba dang / gnyen po sdom pa gnyis ka shes pa kho na la 'dod pa'i phyir/ des na so thar sdom pa'i gtong rgyu bslab pa phul bas de gtong ste/ de'i mi mthun phyogs khas blangs pa'i phyir/ dge rtsa chad pas de gtong ste/ sdom pa'i rten gzhi med pa'i phyir/ dge tshul la pham pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes byas/ dge slong la pham pa byung bas gtong ste/ mi mthun phyogs kyis gnyen po nyams par byas pa'i phyir/

bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa mtshan mo mtha'i skad cig ma 'das pa tsam gyis gtong ba ma yin te/ dge slong gi sdom pa shi 'phos pa tsam gyis mi gtong ba gang zhig rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bslab pa phul ba/ dge rtsa chad pa/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba'i rtsa ltung / kun dkris chen po'i sgo nas spyad pa'i byang sems kyi rtsa ltung rnams byang sems sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin te/ byang sa las/ mdor bsdu na gnyis kho nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa gtong bar 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa yongs su btang ba dang / pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos kyi kun nas dkris pa chen po kun nas spyad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'o na kun dkris che chung gi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa'i rtsa ltung dang por spyad pa tsam ni chung ngu / grangs mang du spyad pa ni 'bring / de'i steng du kha na ma tho ba la mi 'jigs shing dga' spro dang bcas shing yon tan can du bltas pa'i sgo nas spyod pa ni chen po ste/ byang sa las/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po 'di dag rgyun ma chad par kun tu spyod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa chung ngu tsam yang mi skyed pa dang / des mgu bar byed cing de la dga' bar byed pa dang / de nyid la yon tan du lta ba can du gyur ba 'di ni kun nas dkris pa chen po yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ltung tsam byang sems sdom pa'i gtong rgyu ma yin te/ byang sa las/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu bzhi po 'di dag ni kun nas dkris pa chung ngu dang 'bring gis ni/ byang sems kyi tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa de byang chub sems dpas gtong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bdag nyid chen po'i chag lo'i dris lan las/
